there.def: In or at that place; "[They] there left me and my man, both bound together." Shak.

right.def: Straight; direct; not crooked; as, a right line.

about.def: Around; all round; on every side of.

think.def: To seem or appear; , and methought.

going.def: The act of moving in any manner; traveling; as, the going is bad.

would.def: Commonly used as an auxiliary verb, either in the past tense or in the conditional or optative present.

could.def: Was, should be, or would be, able, capable, or susceptible.

never.def: Not ever; not at any time; at no time, whether past, present, or future.

sorry.def: Grieved for the loss of some good; pained for some evil; feeling regret; , but formerly often used to express deeper feeling.

thank.def: A expression of gratitude; an acknowledgment expressive of a sense of favor or kindness received; obligation, claim, or desert, or gratitude;.

doing.def: Anything done; a deed; an action good or bad; hence, in the plural, conduct; behavior.

thing.def: Whatever exists, or is conceived to exist, as a separate entity, whether animate or inanimate; any separable or distinguishable object of thought.

first.def: Preceding all others of a series or kind; the ordinal of one; earliest; as, the first day of a month; the first year of a reign.

still.def: Motionless; at rest; quiet; as, to stand still; to lie or sit still.

their.def: The possessive case of the personal pronoun they; as, their houses; their country.

again.def: In return, back; as, bring us word again.

other.def: Either;; [Obs.] Other of chalk, other of glass.

after.def: Next; later in time; subsequent; succeeding; as, an after period of life.

night.def: That part of the natural day when the sun is beneath the horizon, or the time from sunset to sunrise; esp., the time between dusk and dawn, when there is no light of the sun, but only moonlight, starlight, or artificial light.

great.def: Large in space; of much size; big; immense; enormous; expanded; ; as, a great house, ship, farm, plain, distance, length.

years.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of year; The time of the apparent revolution of the sun trough the ecliptic; the period occupied by the earth in making its revolution around the sun, called the astronomical year; also, a period more or less nearly agreeing with this, adopted by various nations as a measure of time, and called the civil year; as, the common lunar year of 354 days, still in use among the Mohammedans; the year of 360 days, etc.

leave.def: To send out leaves; to leaf;.

money.def: A piece of metal, as gold, silver, copper, etc., coined, or stamped, and issued by the sovereign authority as a medium of exchange in financial transactions between citizens and with government; also, any number of such pieces; coin.

place.def: Any portion of space regarded as measured off or distinct from all other space, or appropriated to some definite object or use; position; ground; site; spot; rarely, unbounded space.

which.def: Of what sort or kind; what; what a; who.

house.def: A structure intended or used as a habitation or shelter for animals of any kind; but especially, a building or edifice for the habitation of man; a dwelling place, a mansion.

every.def: All the parts which compose a whole collection or aggregate number, considered in their individuality, all taken separately one by one, out of an indefinite bumber.

being.def: Existing; Note: Being was formerly used where we now use having.

world.def: The earth and the surrounding heavens; the creation; the system of created things; existent creation; the universe.

three.def: One more than two; two and one.

woman.def: An adult female person; a grown-up female person, as distinguished from a man or a child; sometimes, any female person.

ready.def: Prepared for what one is about to do or experience; equipped or supplied with what is needed for some act or event; prepared for immediate movement or action; as, the troops are ready to march; ready for the journey.

happy.def: Favored by hap, luck, or fortune; lucky; fortunate; successful; prosperous; satisfying desire; as, a happy expedient; a happy effort; a happy venture; a happy omen.

haven.def: A bay, recess, or inlet of the sea, or the mouth of a river, which affords anchorage and shelter for shipping; a harbor; a port.

whole.def: Containing the total amount, number, etc.; comprising all the parts; free from deficiency; all; total; entire; as, the whole earth; the whole solar system; the whole army; the whole nation.

while.def: Space of time, or continued duration, esp.

since.def: From a definite past time until now; as, he went a month ago, and I have not seen him since.

guess.def: To form an opinion concerning, without knowledge or means of knowledge; to judge of at random; to conjecture.

bring.def: To convey to the place where the speaker is or is to be; to bear from a more distant to a nearer place; to fetch.

alone.def: Quite by one's self; apart from, or exclusive of, others; single; solitary;.

looks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of look; To direct the eyes for the purpose of seeing something; to direct the eyes toward an object; to observe with the eyes while keeping them directed; , often in a special or figurative sense.

wants.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of want; The state of not having; the condition of being without anything; absence or scarcity of what is needed or desired; deficiency; lack; as, a want of power or knowledge for any purpose; want of food and clothing.

heart.def: A hollow, muscular organ, which, by contracting rhythmically, keeps up the circulation of the blood.

worry.def: To harass by pursuit and barking; to attack repeatedly; also, to tear or mangle with the teeth.

watch.def: The act of watching; forbearance of sleep; vigil; wakeful, vigilant, or constantly observant attention; close observation; guard; preservative or preventive vigilance; formerly, a watching or guarding by night.

music.def: The science and the art of tones, or musical sounds, i.e., sounds of higher or lower pitch, begotten of uniform and synchronous vibrations, as of a string at various degrees of tension; the science of harmonical tones which treats of the principles of harmony, or the properties, dependences, and relations of tones to each other; the art of combining tones in a manner to please the ear.

young.def: Not long born; still in the first part of life; not yet arrived at adolescence, maturity, or age; not old; juvenile; ; as, a young child; a young man; a young fawn.

water.def: The fluid which descends from the clouds in rain, and which forms rivers, lakes, seas, etc.

stuff.def: Material which is to be worked up in any process of manufacture.

under.def: Below or lower, in place or position, with the idea of being covered; lower than; beneath; ; as, he stood under a tree; the carriage is under cover; a cellar extends under the whole house.

death.def: The cessation of all vital phenomena without capability of resuscitation, either in animals or plants.

crazy.def: Characterized by weakness or feeblness; decrepit; broken; falling to decay; shaky; unsafe.

drink.def: To swallow anything liquid, for quenching thirst or other purpose; to imbibe; to receive or partake of, as if in satisfaction of thirst; as, to drink from a spring.

times.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of time; Duration, considered independently of any system of measurement or any employment of terms which designate limited portions thereof.

check.def: A word of warning denoting that the king is in danger; such a menace of a player's king by an adversary's move as would, if it were any other piece, expose it to immediate capture.

hands.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of hand; That part of the fore limb below the forearm or wrist in man and monkeys, and the corresponding part in many other animals; manus; paw.

means.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of mean; To have in the mind, as a purpose, intention, etc.; to intend; to purpose; to design; as, what do you mean to do What mean ye by this service Ex.

makes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of make; A companion; a mate; often, a husband or a wife.

asked.def: Past tense or past participle of ask; To request; to seek to obtain by words; to petition; to solicit; - - often with of, in the sense of from, before the person addressed.

close.def: To stop, or fill up, as an opening; to shut; as, to close the eyes; to close a door.

party.def: A part or portion; [Obs.] "The most party of the time." Chaucer.

comes.def: The answer to the theme in a fugue.

shall.def: To owe; to be under obligation for.

story.def: A set of rooms on the same floor or level; a floor, or the space between two floors.

least.def: Smallest, either in size or degree; shortest; lowest; most unimportant; as, the least insect; the least mercy; the least space.

fight.def: To strive or contened for victory, with armies or in single combat; to attempt to defeat, subdue, or destroy an enemy, either by blows or weapons; to contend in arms;.

girls.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of girl; A young person of either sex; a child.

stand.def: To be at rest in an erect position; to be fixed in an upright or firm position; as: To be supported on the feet, in an erect or nearly erect position; , sit, kneel, etc.

child.def: A son or a daughter; a male or female descendant, in the first degree; the immediate progeny of human parents; , legitimate offspring.

hours.def: Goddess of the seasons, or of the hours of the day.

speak.def: To utter words or articulate sounds, as human beings; to express thoughts by words; as, the organs may be so obstructed that a man may not be able to speak.

truth.def: The quality or being true; as: ; exact accordance with that which is, or has been; or shall be.

blood.def: The fluid which circulates in the principal vascular system of animals, carrying nourishment to all parts of the body, and bringing away waste products to be excreted.

break.def: To strain apart; to sever by fracture; to divide with violence; as, to break a rope or chain; to break a seal; to break an axle; to break rocks or coal; to break a lock.

trust.def: Assured resting of the mind on the integrity, veracity, justice, friendship, or other sound principle, of another person; confidence; reliance; reliance.

yours.def: See the Note under Your; See the Note under Your.

seems.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of seem; To appear, or to appear to be; to have a show or semblance; to present an appearance; to look; to strike one's apprehension or fancy as being; to be taken as.

front.def: The forehead or brow, the part of the face above the eyes; sometimes, also, the whole face.

hurry.def: To hasten; to impel to greater speed; to urge on.

along.def: By the length; in a line with the length; lengthwise.

light.def: That agent, force, or action in nature by the operation of which upon the organs of sight, objects are rendered visible or luminous.

needs.def: Of necessity; necessarily; indispensably; , and equivalent to of need.

clear.def: Free from opaqueness; transparent; bright; light; luminous; unclouded.

order.def: Regular arrangement; any methodical or established succession or harmonious relation; method; system; as: Of material things, like the books in a library.

black.def: Destitute of light, or incapable of reflecting it; of the color of soot or coal; of the darkest or a very dark color, the opposite of white; characterized by such a color; as, black cloth; black hair or eyes.

alive.def: Having life, in opposition to dead; living; being in a state in which the organs perform their functions; as, an animal or a plant which is alive.

cause.def: That which produces or effects a result; that from which anything proceeds, and without which it would not exist.

ahead.def: In or to the front; in advance; onward.

sighs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of sigh; To inhale a larger quantity of air than usual, and immediately expel it; to make a deep single audible respiration, especially as the result or involuntary expression of fatigue, exhaustion, grief, sorrow, or the like.

white.def: Reflecting to the eye all the rays of the spectrum combined; not tinted with any of the proper colors or their mixtures; having the color of pure snow; snowy; : black or dark; as, white paper; a white skin.

small.def: Having little size, compared with other things of the same kind; little in quantity or degree; diminutive; not large or extended in dimension; not great; not much; inconsiderable; as, a small man; a small river.

lives.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of live; To be alive; to have life; to have, as an animal or a plant, the capacity of assimilating matter as food, and to be dependent on such assimilation for a continuance of existence; as, animals and plants that live to a great age are long in reaching maturity.

uncle.def: The brother of one's father or mother; also applied to an aunt's husband; , and of nephew and niece in relationship.

earth.def: The globe or planet which we inhabit; the world, in distinction from the sun, moon, or stars.

shoot.def: An inclined plane, either artificial or natural, down which timber, coal, etc., are caused to slide; also, a narrow passage, either natural or artificial, in a stream, where the water rushes rapidly; esp., a channel, having a swift current, connecting the ends of a bend in the stream, so as to shorten the course.

touch.def: To come in contact with; to hit or strike lightly against; to extend the hand, foot, or the like, so as to reach or rest on.

sound.def: The air bladder of a fish; as, cod sounds are an esteemed article of food.

human.def: Belonging to man or mankind; having the qualities or attributes of a man; of or pertaining to man or to the race of man; as, a human voice; human shape; human nature; human sacrifices.

drive.def: To impel or urge onward by force in a direction away from one, or along before one; to push forward; to compel to move on; to communicate motion to; as, to drive cattle; to drive a nail; smoke drives persons from a room.

daddy.def: An informal term used by children for a father.

words.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of word; The spoken sign of a conception or an idea; an articulate or vocal sound, or a combination of articulate and vocal sounds, uttered by the human voice, and by custom expressing an idea or ideas; a single component part of human speech or language; a constituent part of a sentence; a term; a vocable.

dance.def: To move with measured steps, or to a musical accompaniment; to go through, either alone or in company with others, with a regulated succession of movements, to the sound of music; to trip or leap rhytmically.

catch.def: To lay hold on; to seize, especially with the hand; to grasp in motion, with the effect of holding; as, to catch a ball.

sense.def: A faculty, possessed by animals, of perceiving external objects by means of impressions made upon certain organs of the body, or of perceiving changes in the condition of the body; as, the senses of sight, smell, hearing, taste, and touch.

dream.def: The thoughts, or series of thoughts, or imaginary transactions, which occupy the mind during sleep; a sleeping vision.

write.def: To set down, as legible characters; to form the conveyance of meaning; to inscribe on any material by a suitable instrument; as, to write the characters called letters; to write figures.

voice.def: Sound uttered by the mouth, especially that uttered by human beings in speech or song; sound thus uttered considered as possessing some special quality or character; as, the human voice; a pleasant voice; a low voice.

sweet.def: Having an agreeable taste or flavor such as that of sugar; saccharine; ; as, a sweet beverage; sweet fruits; sweet oranges.

lucky.def: Favored by luck; fortunate; meeting with good success or good fortune; ; as, a lucky adventurer.

jesus.def: The Savior; the name of the Son of God as announced by the angel to his parents; the personal name of Our Lord, in distinction from Christ, his official appellation.

quiet.def: In a state of rest or calm; without stir, motion, or agitation; still; as, a quiet sea; quiet air.

weeks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of week; A period of seven days, usually that reckoned from one Sabbath or Sunday to the next.

loved.def: Past tense or past participle of love; A feeling of strong attachment induced by that which delights or commands admiration; preëminent kindness or devotion to another; affection; tenderness; as, the love of brothers and sisters.

learn.def: To gain knowledge or information of; to ascertain by inquiry, study, or investigation; to receive instruction concerning; to fix in the mind; to acquire understanding of, or skill; as, to learn the way; to learn a lesson; to learn dancing; to learn to skate; to learn the violin; to learn the truth about something.

early.def: Soon; in good season; seasonably; betimes; as, come early.

clean.def: Free from dirt or filth; as, clean clothes.

piece.def: A fragment or part of anything separated from the whole, in any manner, as by cutting, splitting, breaking, or tearing; a part; a portion; as, a piece of sugar; to break in pieces.

throw.def: Pain; especially, pain of travail; throe.

worth.def: To be; to become; to betide; , woe worth the day, woe worth the man, etc., in which the verb is in the imperative, and the nouns day, man, etc., are in the dative.

quick.def: Alive; living; animate;; Not fully quyke, ne fully dead they were.

state.def: The circumstances or condition of a being or thing at any given time.

works.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of work; Exertion of strength or faculties; physical or intellectual effort directed to an end; industrial activity; toil; employment; sometimes, specifically, physically labor.

weird.def: Fate; destiny; one of the Fates, or Norns; also, a prediction.

chief.def: The head or leader of any body of men; a commander, as of an army; a head man, as of a tribe, clan, or family; a person in authority who directs the work of others; the pricipal actio or agent.

tired.def: Past tense or past participle of tire; A tier, row, or rank.

class.def: A group of individuals ranked together as possessing common characteristics; as, the different classes of society; the educated class; the lower classes.

worse.def: Bad, ill, evil, or corrupt, in a greater degree; more bad or evil; less good; specifically, in poorer health; more sick;.

court.def: An inclosed space; a courtyard; an uncovered area shut in by the walls of a building, or by different building; also, a space opening from a street and nearly surrounded by houses; a blind alley.

marry.def: To unite in wedlock or matrimony; to perform the ceremony of joining, as a man and a woman, for life; to constitute husband and wife according to the laws or customs of the place.

movie.def: A moving picture or a moving picture show;.

mouth.def: The opening through which an animal receives food; the aperture between the jaws or between the lips; also, the cavity, containing the tongue and teeth, between the lips and the pharynx; the buccal cavity.

month.def: One of the twelve portions into which the year is divided; the twelfth part of a year, corresponding nearly to the length of a synodic revolution of the moon,.

lying.def: of Lie, to tell a falsehood.

train.def: To draw along; to trail; to drag.

seven.def: One more than six; six and one added; as, seven days make one week.

hotel.def: A house for entertaining strangers or travelers; an inn or public house, of the better class.

table.def: To form into a table or catalogue; to tabulate; as, to table fines.

buddy.def: A close friend or informal companion.

using.def: Present participle or gerund of us; The persons speaking, regarded as an object; ourselves;.

floor.def: The bottom or lower part of any room; the part upon which we stand and upon which the movables in the room are supported.

swear.def: To affirm or utter a solemn declaration, with an appeal to God for the truth of what is affirmed; to make a promise, threat, or resolve on oath; also, to affirm solemnly by some sacred object, or one regarded as sacred, as the Bible, the Koran, etc.

spend.def: To weigh or lay out; to dispose of; to part with; as, to spend money for clothing.

space.def: Extension, considered independently of anything which it may contain; that which makes extended objects conceivable and possible.

group.def: A cluster, crowd, or throng; an assemblage, either of persons or things, collected without any regular form or arrangement; as, a group of men or of trees; a group of isles.

peace.def: A state of quiet or tranquillity; freedom from disturbance or agitation; calm; repose; specifically: Exemption from, or cessation of, war with public enemies.

force.def: To stuff; to lard; to farce.

short.def: Not long; having brief length or linear extension; as, a short distance; a short piece of timber; a short flight.

enjoy.def: To take pleasure or satisfaction in the possession or experience of; to feel or perceive with pleasure; to be delighted with; as, to enjoy the dainties of a feast; to enjoy conversation.

crime.def: Any violation of law, either divine or human; an omission of a duty commanded, or the commission of an act forbidden by law.

horse.def: (Zoöl.) A hoofed quadruped of the genus Equus; especially, the domestic horse , which was domesticated in Egypt and Asia at a very early period.

count.def: To tell or name one by one, or by groups, for the purpose of ascertaining the whole number of units in a collection; to number; to enumerate; to compute; to reckon.

honor.def: Esteem due or paid to worth; high estimation; respect; consideration; reverence; veneration; manifestation of respect or reverence.

lunch.def: A luncheon; specifically, a light repast between breakfast and dinner.

miles.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of mile; A certain measure of distance, being equivalent in England and the United States to 320 poles or rods, or 5,280 feet.

radio.def: The transmission and reception of electromagnetic waves carrying sound messages or signals.

idiot.def: A man in private station, as distinguished from one holding a public office.

paper.def: A substance in the form of thin sheets or leaves intended to be written or printed on, or to be used in wrapping.

eight.def: An island in a river; an ait.

cover.def: To overspread the surface of with another; as, to cover wood with paint or lacquer; to cover a table with a cloth.

major.def: Greater in number, quantity, or extent; as, the major part of the assembly; the major part of the revenue; the major part of the territory.

stick.def: A small shoot, or branch, separated, as by a cutting, from a tree or shrub; also, any stem or branch of a tree, of any size, cut for fuel or timber.

offer.def: To present, as an act of worship; to immolate; to sacrifice; to present in prayer or devotion;.

smart.def: To feel a lively, pungent local pain; ; as, my finger smarts; these wounds smart.

relax.def: To make lax or loose; to make less close, firm, rigid, tense, or the like; to slacken; to loosen; to open; as, to relax a rope or cord; to relax the muscles or sinews.

brain.def: The whitish mass of soft matter which is inclosed in the cartilaginous or bony cranium of vertebrate animals.

proud.def: Feeling or manifesting pride, in a good or bad sense; as: Possessing or showing too great self-esteem; overrating one's excellences; hence, arrogant; haughty; lordly; presumptuous.

dress.def: To direct; to put right or straight; to regulate; to order.

scene.def: The structure on which a spectacle or play is exhibited; the part of a theater in which the acting is done, with its adjuncts and decorations; the stage.

saved.def: Past tense or past participle of save; The herb sage, or salvia; [Obs.] Chaucer.

tough.def: Having the quality of flexibility without brittleness; yielding to force without breaking; capable of resisting great strain; as, the ligaments of animals are remarkably tough.

feels.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of feel; To perceive by the touch; to take cognizance of by means of the nerves of sensation distributed all over the body, especially by those of the skin; to have sensation excited by contact of with the body or limbs.

drunk.def: Intoxicated with, or as with, strong drink; inebriated; drunken; - - never used attributively, but always predicatively; as, the man is drunk.

share.def: The part of a plow which cuts the ground at the bottom of a furrow; a plowshare.

laugh.def: To show mirth, satisfaction, or derision, by peculiar movement of the muscles of the face, particularly of the mouth, causing a lighting up of the face and eyes, and usually accompanied by the emission of explosive or chuckling sounds from the chest and throat; to indulge in laughter.

smell.def: To perceive by the olfactory nerves, or organs of smell; to have a sensation of, excited through the nasal organs when affected by the appropriate materials or qualities; to obtain the scent of; as, to smell a rose; to smell perfumes.

calls.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of call; To command or request to come or be present; to summon; as, to call a servant.

spent.def: Exhausted; worn out; having lost energy or motive force.

third.def: Next after the second; coming after two others; ; as, the thirdhour in the day.

visit.def: To go or come to see, as for the purpose of friendship, business, curiosity, etc.; to attend; to call upon; as, the physician visits his patient.

judge.def: A public officer who is invested with authority to hear and determine litigated causes, and to administer justice between parties in courts held for that purpose.

moved.def: Past tense or past participle of move; To cause to change place or posture in any manner; to set in motion; to carry, convey, draw, or push from one place to another; to impel; to stir; as, the wind moves a vessel; the horse moves a carriage.

prove.def: To try or to ascertain by an experiment, or by a test or standard; to test; as, to prove the strength of gunpowder or of ordnance; to prove the contents of a vessel by a standard measure.

loves.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of love; A feeling of strong attachment induced by that which delights or commands admiration; preëminent kindness or devotion to another; affection; tenderness; as, the love of brothers and sisters.

carry.def: To convey or transport in any manner from one place to another; to bear;.

teach.def: To impart the knowledge of; to give intelligence concerning; to impart, as knowledge before unknown, or rules for practice; to inculcate as true or important; to exhibit impressively; as, to teach arithmetic, dancing, music, or the like; to teach morals.

upset.def: To set up; to put upright.

green.def: Having the color of grass when fresh and growing; resembling that color of the solar spectrum which is between the yellow and the blue; verdant; emerald.

liked.def: Past tense or past participle of like; Having the same, or nearly the same, appearance, qualities, or characteristics; resembling; similar to; similar; alike; ; as, they are like each other in features, complexion, and many traits of character.

store.def: That which is accumulated, or massed together; a source from which supplies may be drawn; hence, an abundance; a great quantity, or a great number.

likes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of like; Having the same, or nearly the same, appearance, qualities, or characteristics; resembling; similar to; similar; alike; ; as, they are like each other in features, complexion, and many traits of character.

doubt.def: To waver in opinion or judgment; to be in uncertainty as to belief respecting anything; to hesitate in belief; to be undecided as to the truth of the negative or the affirmative proposition; to b e undetermined.

wrote.def: To root with the snout; See 1st Root.

field.def: Cleared land; land suitable for tillage or pasture; cultivated ground; the open country.

south.def: That one of the four cardinal points directly opposite to the north; the region or direction to the right or direction to the right of a person who faces the east.

glass.def: A hard, brittle, translucent, and commonly transparent substance, white or colored, having a conchoidal fracture, and made by fusing together sand or silica with lime, potash, soda, or lead oxide.

dying.def: In the act of dying; destined to death; mortal; perishable; as, dying bodies.

whose.def: The possessive case of who or which.

plane.def: Any tree of the genus Platanus.

north.def: That one of the four cardinal points of the compass, at any place, which lies in the direction of the true meridian, and to the left hand of a person facing the east; the direction opposite to the south.

madam.def: A gentlewoman; , especially an elderly or a married lady; , at the beginning of a letter, to a woman.

truck.def: A small wheel, as of a vehicle; specifically , a small strong wheel, as of wood or iron, for a gun carriage.

board.def: A piece of timber sawed thin, and of considerable length and breadth as compared with the thickness, , etc.

magic.def: A comprehensive name for all of the pretended arts which claim to produce effects by the assistance of supernatural beings, or departed spirits, or by a mastery of secret forces in nature attained by a study of occult science, including enchantment, conjuration, witchcraft, sorcery, necromancy, incantation, etc.

rules.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of rule; That which is prescribed or laid down as a guide for conduct or action; a governing direction for a specific purpose; an authoritative enactment; a regulation; a prescription; a precept; as, the rules of various societies; the rules governing a school; a rule of etiquette or propriety; the rules of cricket.

gives.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of give; To bestow without receiving a return; to confer without compensation; to impart, as a possession; to grant, as authority or permission; to yield up or allow.

dirty.def: Defiled with dirt; foul; nasty; filthy; not clean or pure; serving to defile; as, dirty hands; dirty water; a dirty white.

shoes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of shoe; A covering for the human foot, usually made of leather, having a thick and somewhat stiff sole and a lighter top.

knock.def: To drive or be driven against something; to strike against something; to clash; as, one heavy body knocks against another.

worst.def: Bad, evil, or pernicious, in the highest degree, whether in a physical or moral sense.

final.def: Pertaining to the end or conclusion; last; terminating; ultimate; as, the final day of a school term.

turns.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of turn; To cause to move upon a center, or as if upon a center; to give circular motion to; to cause to revolve; to cause to move round, either partially, wholly, or repeatedly; to make to change position so as to present other sides in given directions; to make to face otherwise; as, to turn a wheel or a spindle; to turn the body or the head.

match.def: Anything used for catching and retaining or communicating fire, made of some substance which takes fire readily, or remains burning some time; esp., a small strip or splint of wood dipped at one end in a substance which can be easily ignited by friction, as a preparation of phosphorus or chlorate of potassium.

gasps.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of gasp; To open the mouth wide in catching the breath, or in laborious respiration; to labor for breath; to respire convulsively; to pant violently.

grand.def: Of large size or extent; great; extensive; hence, relatively great; greatest; chief; principal; as, a grand mountain; a grand army; a grand mistake.

blame.def: To censure; to express disapprobation of; to find fault with; to reproach.

drugs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of drug; To drudge; to toil laboriously.

rings.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of ring; To cause to sound, especially by striking, as a metallic body; as, to ring a bell.

named.def: Past tense or past participle of name; The title by which any person or thing is known or designated; a distinctive specific appellation, whether of an individual or a class.

paris.def: A plant common in Europe ; herb Paris; truelove.

books.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of book; A collection of sheets of paper, or similar material, blank, written, or printed, bound together; commonly, many folded and bound sheets containing continuous printing or writing.

price.def: The sum or amount of money at which a thing is valued, or the value which a seller sets on his goods in market; that for which something is bought or sold, or offered for sale; equivalent in money or other means of exchange; current value or rate paid or demanded in market or in barter; cost.

smoke.def: The visible exhalation, vapor, or substance that escapes, or expelled, from a burning body, especially from burning vegetable matter, as wood, coal, peat, or the like.

favor.def: Kind regard; propitious aspect; countenance; friendly disposition; kindness; good will.

smile.def: To express amusement, pleasure, moderate joy, or love and kindness, by the features of the face; to laugh silently.

guard.def: To protect from danger; to secure against surprise, attack, or injury; to keep in safety; to defend; to shelter; to shield from surprise or attack; to protect by attendance; toaccompany for protection; to vare for.

begin.def: To have or commence an independent or first existence; to take rise; to commence.

enemy.def: One hostile to another; one who hates, and desires or attempts the injury of, another; a foe; an adversary; as, an enemy of or to a person; an enemy to truth, or to falsehood.

allow.def: To praise; to approve of; hence, to sanction.

apart.def: Separately, in regard to space or company; in a state of separation as to place; aside.

stage.def: A floor or story of a house.

bunch.def: A protuberance; a hunch; a knob or lump; a hump.

admit.def: To suffer to enter; to grant entrance, whether into a place, or into the mind, or consideration; to receive; to take; as, they were into his house; to admit a serious thought into the mind; to admit evidence in the trial of a cause.

names.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of nam; Am not; [Obs.] of Nim.

steal.def: A handle; a stale, or stele.

cross.def: A gibbet, cosisting of two pieces of timber placed transversely upon one another, in various forms, as a T, or +, with the horizontal piece below the upper end of the upright, or as an X.

waste.def: Desolate; devastated; stripped; bare; hence, dreary; dismal; gloomy; cheerless.

fired.def: Past tense or past participle of fire; The evolution of light and heat in the combustion of bodies; combustion; state of ignition.

taste.def: To try by the touch; to handle; as, to taste a bow.

build.def: To erect or construct, as an edifice or fabric of any kind; to form by uniting materials into a regular structure; to fabricate; to make; to raise.

track.def: A mark left by something that has passed along; as, the track, or wake, of a ship; the track of a meteor; the track of a sled or a wheel.

above.def: In or to a higher place; higher than; on or over the upper surface; over;.

video.def: The recording, reproducing, or broadcasting of moving visual images on a screen.

fresh.def: Possessed of original life and vigor; new and strong; unimpaired; sound.

study.def: A setting of the mind or thoughts upon a subject; hence, application of mind to books, arts, or science, or to any subject, for the purpose of acquiring knowledge.

crowd.def: To push, to press, to shove.

treat.def: To handle; to manage; to use; to bear one's self toward; as, to treat prisoners cruelly; to treat children kindly.

empty.def: Containing nothing; not holding or having anything within; void of contents or appropriate contents; not filled; , as a box, room, house, etc.; as, an empty chest, room, purse, or pitcher; an empty stomach; empty shackles.

level.def: A line or surface to which, at every point, a vertical or plumb line is perpendicular; a line or surface which is everywhere parallel to the surface of still water; , and is a curve or surface in which all points are equally distant from the center of the earth, or rather would be so if the earth were an exact sphere.

plans.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of plan; A draught or form; properly, a representation drawn on a plane, as a map or a chart; especially, a top view, as of a machine, or the representation or delineation of a horizontal section of anything, as of a building; a graphic representation; a diagram.

built.def: Shape; build; form of structure; as, the built of a ship.

raise.def: To cause to rise; to bring from a lower to a higher place; to lift upward; to elevate; to heave; as, to raise a stone or weight.

extra.def: Beyond what is due, usual, expected, or necessary; additional; supernumerary; also, extraordinarily good; superior; as, extra work; extra pay.

mommy.def: An informal term used by children for a mother.

keeps.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of keep; To care; to desire; [Obs.] I kepe not of armes for to yelp [boast].

shame.def: A painful sensation excited by a consciousness of guilt or impropriety, or of having done something which injures reputation, or of the exposure of that which nature or modesty prompts us to conceal.

awful.def: Oppressing with fear or horror; appalling; terrible; as, an awful scene.

large.def: Exceeding most other things of like in bulk, capacity, quantity, superficial dimensions, or number of constituent units; big; great; capacious; extensive; ; as, a nlarge horse; a large house or room; a large lake or pool; a large jug or spoon; a large vineyard; a large army; a large city.

local.def: Of or pertaining to a particular place, or to a definite region or portion of space; restricted to one place or region; as, a local custom.

stone.def: Concreted earthy or mineral matter; also, any particular mass of such matter; as, a house built of stone; the boy threw a stone; pebbles are rounded stones.

grace.def: The exercise of love, kindness, mercy, favor; disposition to benefit or serve another; favor bestowed or privilege conferred.

pants.def: An outer garment covering the body from the waist to the ankles, with a separate part for each leg.

faith.def: Belief; the assent of the mind to the truth of what is declared by another, resting solely and implicitly on his authority and veracity; reliance on testimony.

knife.def: An instrument composed of a blade fixed into a handle, used for cutting or as a weapon.

devil.def: The Evil One; Satan, represented as the tempter and spiritual of mankind.

stars.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of star; One of the innumerable luminous bodies seen in the heavens; any heavenly body other than the sun, moon, comets, and nebulæ.

folks.def: In Anglo-Saxon times, the people of a group of townships or villages; a community; a tribe.

shows.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of show; To exhibit or present to view; to place in sight; to display; , and often with an indirect object denoting the person or thing seeing or beholding; as, to show a house; show your colors; shopkeepers show customers goods.

blind.def: Destitute of the sense of seeing, either by natural defect or by deprivation; without sight.

ghost.def: The spirit; the soul of man.

tells.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of tell; To mention one by one, or piece by piece; to recount; to enumerate; to reckon; to number; to count; as, to tell money.

speed.def: Prosperity in an undertaking; favorable issue; success.

trial.def: The act of trying or testing in any manner.

angel.def: A messenger; [R.] The dear good angel of the Spring, The nightingale.

super.def: A contraction of Supernumerary, in sense 2.

plays.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of play; To engage in sport or lively recreation; to exercise for the sake of amusement; to frolic; to spot.

color.def: A property depending on the relations of light to the eye, by which individual and specific differences in the hues and tints of objects are apprehended in vision; as, gay colors; sad colors, etc.

sight.def: The act of seeing; perception of objects by the eye; view; as, to gain sight of land.

games.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of gam; A herd, or school, of whales.

coach.def: A large, closed, four-wheeled carriage, having doors in the sides, and generally a front and back seat inside, each for two persons, and an elevated outside seat in front for the driver.

serve.def: To work for; to labor in behalf of; to exert one's self continuously or statedly for the benefit of; to do service for; to be in the employment of, as an inferior, domestic, serf, slave, hired assistant, official helper, etc.; specifically, in a religious sense, to obey and worship.

ideas.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of idea; The transcript, image, or picture of a visible object, that is formed by the mind; also, a similar image of any object whatever, whether sensible or spiritual.

trick.def: An artifice or stratagem; a cunning contrivance; a sly procedure, usually with a dishonest intent; as, a trick in trade.

truly.def: In a true manner; according to truth; in agreement with fact; as, to state things truly; the facts are truly represented.

nurse.def: One who nourishes; a person who supplies food, tends, or brings up; as: A woman who has the care of young children; especially, one who suckles an infant not her own.

chair.def: A movable single seat with a back.

hurts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of hurt; A band on a trip-hammer helve, bearing the trunnions.

brown.def: Of a dark color, of various shades between black and red or yellow.

heads.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of head; The anterior or superior part of an animal, containing the brain, or chief ganglia of the nervous system, the mouth, and in the higher animals, the chief sensory organs; poll; cephalon.

shirt.def: A loose under-garment for the upper part of the body, made of cotton, linen, or other material; - garment of either sex, now commonly restricted to that worn by men and boys.

guest.def: A visitor; a person received and entertained in one's house or at one's table; a visitor entertained without pay.

cards.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of card; A piece of pasteboard, or thick paper, blank or prepared for various uses; as, a playing card; a visiting card; a card of invitation; pl.

balls.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of ball; Any round or roundish body or mass; a sphere or globe; as, a ball of twine; a ball of snow.

ended.def: Past tense or past participle of end; The extreme or last point or part of any material thing considered lengthwise ; hence, extremity, in general; the concluding part; termination; close; limit; as, the end of a field, line, pole, road; the end of a year, of a discourse; put an end to pain; : beginning, when used of anything having a first part.

usual.def: Such as is in common use; such as occurs in ordinary practice, or in the ordinary course of events; customary; ordinary; habitual; common.

aware.def: Watchful; vigilant or on one's guard against danger or difficulty.

proof.def: Any effort, process, or operation designed to establish or discover a fact or truth; an act of testing; a test; a trial.

cream.def: The rich, oily, and yellowish part of milk, which, when the milk stands unagitated, rises, and collects on the surface.

total.def: Whole; not divided; entire; full; complete; absolute; as, a total departure from the evidence; a total loss.

birth.def: The act or fact of coming into life, or of being born; ; as, the birth of a son.

noise.def: Sound of any kind; The heavens turn about in a most rapid motion without noise to us perceived.

birds.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bird; Orig., a chicken; the young of a fowl; a young eaglet; a nestling; and hence, a feathered flying animal.

bucks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of buck; Lye or suds in which cloth is soaked in the operation of bleaching, or in which clothes are washed.

focus.def: A point in which the rays of light meet, after being reflected or refrcted, and at which the image is formed; as, the focus of a lens or mirror.

opens.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of open; Free of access; not shut up; not closed; affording unobstructed ingress or egress; not impeding or preventing passage; not locked up or covered over; ; as, an open door, window, road, etc.; also, to inclosed structures or objects; as, open houses, boxes, baskets, bottles, etc.; also, to means of communication or approach by water or land; as, an open harbor or roadstead.

exist.def: To be as a fact and not as a mode; to have an actual or real being, whether material or spiritual.

issue.def: The act of passing or flowing out; a moving out from any inclosed place; egress; as, the issue of water from a pipe, of blood from a wound, of air from a bellows, of people from a house.

sword.def: An offensive weapon, having a long and usually sharp 2.

mayor.def: The chief magistrate of a city or borough; the chief officer of a municipal corporation.

staff.def: A long piece of wood; a stick; the long handle of an instrument or weapon; a pole or srick, used for many purposes; as, a surveyor's staff; the staff of a spear or pike.

lines.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of lin; To yield; to stop; to cease.

split.def: To divide lengthwise; to separate from end to end, esp.

alarm.def: A summons to arms, as on the approach of an enemy.

enter.def: To come or go into; to pass into the interior of; to pass within the outer cover or shell of; to penetrate; to pierce; as, to enter a house, a closet, a country, a door, etc.; the river enters the sea.

brave.def: Bold; courageous; daring; intrepid; ; as, a brave man; a brave act.

model.def: A miniature representation of a thing, with the several parts in due proportion; sometimes, a facsimile of the same size.

based.def: Having a base, or having as a base; supported; as, broad-based.

screw.def: A cylinder, or a cylindrical perforation, having a continuous rib, called the thread, winding round it spirally at a constant inclination, so as to leave a continuous spiral groove, between one turn and the next, , when revolved, motion or pressure in the direction of its axis, by the sliding of the threads of the cylinder in the grooves between the threads of the perforation adapted to it, the former being distinguished as the external, or male screw, or, more usually the screw; the latter as the internal, or female screw, or, more usually, the nut.

cares.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of car; A small vehicle moved on wheels; usually, one having but two wheels and drawn by one horse; a cart.

style.def: An instrument used by the ancients in writing on tablets covered with wax, having one of its ends sharp, and the other blunt, and somewhat expanded, for the purpose of making erasures by smoothing the wax.

spare.def: To use frugally or stintingly, as that which is scarce or valuable; to retain or keep unused; to save.

loose.def: Unbound; untied; unsewed; not attached, fastened, fixed, or confined; as, the loose sheets of a book.

paint.def: To cover with coloring matter; to apply paint to; as, to paint a house, a signboard, etc.

naked.def: Having no clothes on; uncovered; nude; bare; as, a naked body; a naked limb; a naked sword.

sugar.def: A sweet crystalline substance obtained from various plants, especially sugar cane and sugar beet.

doors.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of door; An opening in the wall of a house or of an apartment, by which to go in and out; an entrance way.

block.def: A piece of wood more or less bulky; a solid mass of wood, stone, etc., usually with one or more plane, or approximately plane, faces; as, a block on which a butcher chops his meat; a block by which to mount a horse; children's playing blocks, etc.

fancy.def: The faculty by which the mind forms an image or a representation of anything perceived before; the power of combining and modifying such objects into new pictures or images; the power of readily and happily creating and recalling such objects for the purpose of amusement, wit, or embellishment; imagination.

chest.def: A large box of wood, or other material, having, like a trunk, a lid, but no covering of skin, leather, or cloth.

trade.def: A track; a trail; a way; a path; also, passage; travel; resort.

storm.def: A violent disturbance of the atmosphere, attended by wind, rain, snow, hail, or thunder and lightning; hence, often, a heavy fall of rain, snow, or hail, whether accompanied with wind or not.

lover.def: One who loves; one who is in love; , in the singular, to a person of the male sex.

bread.def: Food made of flour, water, and yeast mixed together and baked in an oven.

legal.def: Created by, permitted by, in conformity with, or relating to, law; as, a legal obligation; a legal standard or test; a legal procedure; a legal claim; a legal trade; anything is legal which the laws do not forbid.

owner.def: One who owns; a rightful proprietor; one who has the legal or rightful title, whether he is the possessor or not.

trees.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of tree; Any perennial woody plant of considerable size and growing with a single trunk.

rough.def: Having inequalities, small ridges, or points, on the surface; not smooth or plain; as, a rough board; a rough stone; rough cloth.

parts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of part; One of the portions, equal or unequal, into which anything is divided, or regarded as divided; something less than a whole; a number, quantity, mass, or the like, regarded as going to make up, with others, a larger number, quantity, mass, etc., whether actually separate or not; a piece; a fragment; a fraction; a division; a member; a constituent.

cases.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of case; A box, sheath, or covering; as, a case for holding goods; a case for spectacles; the case of a watch; the case of a cartridge; a case for a book.

clock.def: A machine for measuring time, indicating the hour and other divisions by means of hands moving on a dial plate.

ocean.def: The whole body of salt water which covers more than three fifths of the surface of the globe; , or great sea.

thief.def: One who steals; one who commits theft or larceny.

bleep.def: A short, high-pitched sound made by an electronic device or audio censor.

smith.def: One who forgess with the hammer; one who works in metals; as, a blacksmith, goldsmith, silversmith, and the like.

bones.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bon; Good; valid as security for something.

plant.def: A vegetable; an organized living being, generally without feeling and voluntary motion, and having, when complete, a root, stem, and leaves, though consisting sometimes only of a single leafy expansion, or a series of cellules, or even a single cellule.

bless.def: To make or pronounce holy; to consecrate And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it.

crash.def: To break in pieces violently; to dash together with noise and violence.

event.def: That which comes, arrives, or happens; that which falls out; any incident, good or bad.

shape.def: To form or create; especially, to mold or make into a particular form; to give proper form or figure to.

royal.def: Kingly; pertaining to the crown or the sovereign; suitable for a king or queen; regal; as, royal power or prerogative; royal domains; the royal family; royal state.

tears.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of tear; A drop of the limpid, saline fluid secreted, normally in small amount, by the lachrymal gland, and diffused between the eye and the eyelids to moisten the parts and facilitate their motion.

giant.def: A man of extraordinari bulk and stature.

woods.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of wood; Mad; insane; possessed; rabid; furious; frantic.

scare.def: To frighten; to strike with sudden fear; to alarm.

stops.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of stop; To close, as an aperture, by filling or by obstructing; as, to stop the ears; hence, to stanch, as a wound.

finds.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of find; To meet with, or light upon, accidentally; to gain the first sight or knowledge of, as of something new, or unknown; hence, to fall in with, as a person.

fixed.def: Securely placed or fastened; settled; established; firm; imovable; unalterable.

walls.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of wall; A kind of knot often used at the end of a rope; a wall knot; a wale.

grant.def: To give over; to make conveyance of; to give the possession or title of; to convey;.

scary.def: Barren land having only a thin coat of grass.

grave.def: To clean, as a vessel's bottom, of barnacles, grass, etc., and pay it over with pitch;.

chase.def: To pursue for the purpose of killing or taking, as an enemy, or game; to hunt.

faces.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of fac; A large ornamental letter used, esp.

badly.def: In a bad manner; poorly; not well; unskillfully; imperfectly; unfortunately; grievously; so as to cause harm; disagreeably; seriously.

shock.def: A pile or assemblage of sheaves of grain, as wheat, rye, or the like, set up in a field, the sheaves varying in number from twelve to sixteen; a stook.

pizza.def: A dish of Italian origin consisting of a flat round bread base topped with cheese and tomato.

image.def: An imitation, representation, or similitude of any person, thing, or act, sculptured, drawn, painted, or otherwise made perceptible to the sight; a visible presentation; a copy; a likeness; an effigy; a picture; a semblance.

plate.def: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

mercy.def: Forbearance to inflict harm under circumstances of provocation, when one has the power to inflict it; compassionate treatment of an offender or adversary; clemency.

shots.def: The refuse of cattle taken from a drove.

terms.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of term; That which limits the extent of anything; limit; extremity; bound; boundary.

crack.def: To break or burst, with or without entire separation of the parts; as, to crack glass; to crack nuts.

jenny.def: A familiar or pet form of the proper name Jane.

below.def: Under, or lower in place; beneath not so high; as, below the moon; below the knee.

march.def: The third month of the year, containing thirty-one days.

india.def: A country in Southern Asia; the two peninsulas of Hither and Farther India; in a restricted sense, Hither India, or Hindostan.

aside.def: On, or to, one side; out of a straight line, course, or direction; at a little distance from the rest; out of the way; apart.

freak.def: To variegate; to checker; to streak.

awake.def: To rouse from sleep.; to wake; to awaken.

prime.def: First in order of time; original; primeval; primitive; primary.

piano.def: Soft; , and with diminished volume of tone.

moves.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of move; To cause to change place or posture in any manner; to set in motion; to carry, convey, draw, or push from one place to another; to impel; to stir; as, the wind moves a vessel; the horse moves a carriage.

value.def: The property or aggregate properties of a thing by which it is rendered useful or desirable, or the degree of such property or sum of properties; worth; excellence; utility; importance.

union.def: The act of uniting or joining two or more things into one, or the state of being united or joined; junction; coalition; combination.

songs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of song; That which is sung or uttered with musical modulations of the voice, whether of a human being or of a bird, insect, etc.

pride.def: A small European lamprey ; , and sandpiper.

pills.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of pill; The peel or skin; [Obs.] "Some be covered over with crusts, or hard pills, as the locusts." Holland.

metal.def: An elementary substance, as sodium, calcium, or copper, whose oxide or hydroxide has basic rather than acid properties, as contrasted with the nonmetals, or metalloids.

candy.def: A sweet food made with sugar or syrup combined with fruit, chocolate, or nuts.

bride.def: A woman newly married, or about to be married.

penny.def: Denoting pound weight for one thousand; , with respect to nails; as, tenpenny nails, nails of which one thousand weight ten pounds.

claim.def: To ask for, or seek to obtain, by virtue of authority, right, or supposed right; to challenge as a right; to demand as due.

solve.def: To explain; to resolve; to unfold; to clear up out to a result or conclusion; as, to solve a doubt; to solve difficulties; to solve a problem.

theme.def: A subject or topic on which a person writes or speaks; a proposition for discussion or argument; a text.

chuck.def: To make a noise resembling that of a hen when she calls her chickens; to cluck.

false.def: Uttering falsehood; unveracious; given to deceit; dishnest; as, a false witness.

punch.def: A beverage composed of wine or distilled liquor, water , sugar, and the juice of lemon, with spice or mint; ; as rum punch, claret punch, champagne punch, etc.

falls.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of fall; To Descend, either suddenly or gradually; particularly, to descend by the force of gravity; to drop; to sink; as, the apple falls; the tide falls; the mercury falls in the barometer.

witch.def: A cone of paper which is placed in a vessel of lard or other fat, and used as a taper.

tires.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of tire; A tier, row, or rank.

toast.def: Sliced bread browned on both sides by exposure to radiant heat.

notes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of not; Wot not; know not; knows not.

april.def: The fourth month of the year.

rooms.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of room; Unobstructed spase; space which may be occupied by or devoted to any object; compass; extent of place, great or small; as, there is not room for a house; the table takes up too much room.

coast.def: The side of a thing; [Obs.] Sir I.

hated.def: Past tense or past participle of hate; To have a great aversion to, with a strong desire that evil should befall the person toward whom the feeling is directed; to dislike intensely; to detest; as, to hate one's enemies; to hate hypocrisy.

steps.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of step; To move the foot in walking; to advance or recede by raising and moving one of the feet to another resting place, or by moving both feet in succession.

beast.def: Any living creature; an animal; , insects, etc.

files.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of fil; imp; of Fall, v.

signs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of sign; That by which anything is made known or represented; that which furnishes evidence; a mark; a token; an indication; a proof.

japan.def: Work varnished and figured in the Japanese manner; also, the varnish or lacquer used in japanning.

shift.def: To divide; to distribute; to apportion.

exact.def: Precisely agreeing with a standard, a fact, or the truth; perfectly conforming; neither exceeding nor falling short in any respect; true; correct; precise; as, the clock keeps exact time; he paid the exact debt; an exact copy of a letter; exact accounts.

score.def: A notch or incision; especially, one that is made as a tally mark; hence, a mark, or line, made for the purpose of account.

marks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of mark; A license of reprisals.

pilot.def: One employed to steer a vessel; a helmsman; a steersman.

armed.def: Furnished with weapons of offense or defense; furnished with the means of security or protection.

grade.def: A step or degree in any series, rank, quality, order; relative position or standing; as, grades of military rank; crimes of every grade; grades of flour.

juice.def: The characteristic fluid of any vegetable or animal substance; the sap or part which can be expressed from fruit, etc.; the fluid part which separates from meat in cooking.

tower.def: A mass of building standing alone and insulated, usually higher than its diameter, but when of great size not always of that proportion.

wheel.def: A circular frame turning about an axis; a rotating disk, whether solid, or a frame composed of an outer rim, spokes or radii, and a central hub or nave, in which is inserted the axle, , in machinery, and for various purposes; as, the wheel of a wagon, of a locomotive, of a mill, of a watch, etc.

fruit.def: Whatever is produced for the nourishment or enjoyment of man or animals by the processes of vegetable growth, as corn, grass, cotton, flax, etc.;.

talks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of talk; To utter words; esp., to converse familiarly; to speak, as in familiar discourse, when two or more persons interchange thoughts.

range.def: To set in a row, or in rows; to place in a regular line or lines, or in ranks; to dispose in the proper order; to rank; as, to range soldiers in line.

youth.def: The quality or state of being young; youthfulness; juvenility.

knees.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of knee; In man, the joint in the middle part of the leg.

alien.def: Not belonging to the same country, land, or government, or to the citizens or subjects thereof; foreign; as, alien subjects, enemies, property, shores.

helps.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of help; To furnish with strength or means for the successful performance of any action or the attainment of any object; to aid; to assist; as, to help a man in his work; to help one to remember; ; as, "Help me scale yon balcony." Longfellow.

route.def: The course or way which is traveled or passed, or is to be passed; a passing; a course; a road or path; a march.

trace.def: One of two straps, chains, or ropes of a harness, extending from the collar or breastplate to a whiffletree attached to a vehicle or thing to be drawn; a tug.

nasty.def: Offensively filthy; very dirty, foul, or defiled; disgusting; nauseous.

tests.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of test; A cupel or cupelling hearth in which precious metals are melted for trial and refinement.

rocks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of rock; ; A distaff used in spinning; the staff or frame about which flax is arranged, and from which the thread is drawn in spinning.

merry.def: Laughingly gay; overflowing with good humor and good spirits; jovial; inclined to laughter or play ; sportive.

snake.def: Any species of the order Ophidia; an ophidian; a serpent, whether harmless or venomous.

actor.def: One who acts, or takes part in any affair; a doer.

anger.def: Trouble; vexation; also, physical pain or smart of a sore, etc.

sharp.def: Having a very thin edge or fine point; of a nature to cut or pierce easily; not blunt or dull; keen.

squad.def: A small party of men assembled for drill, inspection, or other purposes.

kinds.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of kind; Characteristic of the species; belonging to one's nature; natural; native.

sucks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of suck; To draw, as a liquid, by the action of the mouth and tongue, which tends to produce a vacuum, and causes the liquid to rush in by atmospheric pressure; to draw, or apply force to, by exhausting the air.

bored.def: Past tense or past participle of bore; To perforate or penetrate, as a solid body, by turning an auger, gimlet, drill, or other instrument; to make a round hole in or through; to pierce; as, to bore a plank.

chain.def: A series of links or rings, usually of metal, connected, or fitted into one another, used for various purposes, as of support, of restraint, of ornament, of the exertion and transmission of mechanical power, etc.

fully.def: In a full manner or degree; completely; entirely; without lack or defect; adequately; satisfactorily; as, to be fully persuaded of the truth of a proposition.

curse.def: To call upon divine or supernatural power to send injury upon; to imprecate evil upon; to execrate.

leads.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of lead; One of the elements, a heavy, pliable, inelastic metal, having a bright, bluish color, but easily tarnished.

blows.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of blow; To flower; to blossom; to bloom.

climb.def: To ascend or mount laboriously, esp.

trash.def: That which is worthless or useless; rubbish; refuse.

prize.def: That which is taken from another; something captured; a thing seized by force, stratagem, or superior power.

stock.def: The stem, or main body, of a tree or plant; the fixed, strong, firm part; the trunk.

facts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of fact; A doing, making, or preparing.

bravo.def: A daring villain; a bandit; one who sets law at defiance; a professional assassin or murderer.

wings.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of wing; One of the two anterior limbs of a bird, pterodactyl, or bat.

glory.def: Praise, honor, admiration, or distinction, accorded by common consent to a person or thing; high reputation; honorable fame; renown.

apple.def: The fleshy pome or fruit of a rosaceous tree cultivated in numberless varieties in the temperate zones.

films.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of film; A thin skin; a pellicle; a membranous covering, causing opacity; hence, any thin, slight covering.

flesh.def: The aggregate of the muscles, fat, and other tissues which cover the framework of bones in man and other animals; especially, the muscles.

ships.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of ship; Pay; reward; [Obs.] In withholding or abridging of the ship or the hire or the wages of servants.

mummy.def: A dead body embalmed and dried after the manner of the ancient Egyptians; also, a body preserved, by any means, in a dry state, from the process of putrefaction.

panic.def: A plant of the genus Panicum; panic grass; also, the edible grain of some species of panic grass.

minds.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of mind; The intellectual or rational faculty in man; the understanding; the intellect; the power that conceives, judges, or reasons; also, the entire spiritual nature; the soul;.

tiger.def: A very large and powerful carnivore native of Southern Asia and the East Indies.

saint.def: A person sanctified; a holy or godly person; one eminent for piety and virtue; any true Christian, as being redeemed and consecrated to God.

jesse.def: Any representation or suggestion of the genealogy of Christ, in decorative art; as: A genealogical tree represented in stained glass.

solid.def: Having the constituent parts so compact, or so firmly adhering, as to resist the impression or penetration of other bodies; having a fixed form; hard; firm; compact; , like clay, or to incompact, like sand.

chick.def: To sprout, as seed in the ground; to vegetate.

demon.def: A spirit, or immaterial being, holding a middle place between men and deities in pagan mythology.

dozen.def: A collection of twelve objects; a tale or set of twelve; with or without of before the substantive which follows.

swing.def: To move to and fro, as a body suspended in the air; to wave; to vibrate; to oscillate.

molly.def: Same as Mollemoke; A pet or colloquial name for Mary.

mixed.def: Formed by mixing; united; mingled; blended.

stays.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of stay; A large, strong rope, employed to support a mast, by being extended from the head of one mast down to some other, or to some part of the vessel.

sally.def: To leap or rush out; to burst forth; to issue suddenly; as a body of troops from a fortified place to attack besiegers; to make a sally.

daily.def: Happening, or belonging to, each successive day; diurnal; as, daily labor; a daily bulletin.

bound.def: The external or limiting line, either real or imaginary, of any object or space; that which limits or restrains, or within which something is limited or restrained; limit; confine; extent; boundary.

guide.def: To lead or direct in a way; to conduct in a course or path; to pilot; as, to guide a traveler.

roman.def: Of or pertaining to Rome, or the Roman people; like or characteristic of Rome, the Roman people, or things done by Romans; as, Roman fortitude; a Roman aqueduct; Roman art.

couch.def: A long comfortable piece of furniture for several people to sit on; a sofa.

cheer.def: The face; the countenance or its expression.

vegas.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of vega; A brilliant star of the first magnitude, the brightest of those constituting the constellation Lyra.

title.def: An inscription put over or upon anything as a name by which it is known.

fever.def: A diseased state of the system, marked by increased heat, acceleration of the pulse, and a general derangement of the functions, including usually, thirst and loss of appetite.

flash.def: To burst or break forth with a sudden and transient flood of flame and light; as, the lighting flashes vividly; the powder flashed.

siren.def: One of three sea nymphs, , according to some writers, of two, , and to sing with such sweetness that they lured mariners to destruction.

sides.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of side; The margin, edge, verge, or border of a surface; especially , one of the longer edges as distinguished from the shorter edges, called ends; a bounding line of a geometrical figure; as, the side of a field, of a square or triangle, of a river, of a road, etc.

drama.def: A composition, in prose or poetry, accommodated to action, and intended to exhibit a picture of human life, or to depict a series of grave or humorous actions of more than ordinary interest, tending toward some striking result.

adult.def: Having arrived at maturity, or to full size and strength; matured; as, an adult person or plant; an adult ape; an adult age.

kills.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of kill; A kiln; [Obs.] Fuller.

joint.def: The place or part where two things or parts are joined or united; the union of two or more smooth or even surfaces admitting of a close-fitting or junction; junction as, a joint between two pieces of timber; a joint in a pipe.

boots.def: Sturdy footwear covering the foot and ankle, and sometimes the lower or upper leg.

civil.def: Pertaining to a city or state, or to a citizen in his relations to his fellow citizens or to the state; within the city or state.

shine.def: To emit rays of light; to give light; to beam with steady radiance; to exhibit brightness or splendor; as, the sun shines by day; the moon shines by night.

jokes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of joke; Something said for the sake of exciting a laugh; something witty or sportive ; a jest; a witticism; as, to crack good-natured jokes.

argue.def: To invent and offer reasons to support or overthrow a proposition, opinion, or measure; to use arguments; to reason.

trail.def: To hunt by the track; to track.

pussy.def: A pet name for a cat; also, an endearing name for a girl.

shout.def: To utter a sudden and loud outcry, as in joy, triumph, or exultation, or to attract attention, to animate soldiers, etc.

blast.def: A violent gust of wind; And see where surly Winter passes off, Far to the north, and calls his ruffian blasts; His blasts obey, and quit the howling hill.

fifth.def: Next in order after the fourth;.

sweat.def: To excrete sensible moisture from the pores of the skin; to perspire.

costs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of cost; A rib; a side; a region or coast.

mason.def: One whose occupation is to build with stone or brick; also, one who prepares stone for building purposes.

kitty.def: A kitten; also, a pet name or calling name for the cat.

crush.def: To press or bruise between two hard bodies; to squeeze, so as to destroy the natural shape or integrity of the parts, or to force together into a mass; as, to crush grapes.

suits.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of suit; The act of following or pursuing, as game; pursuit.

noble.def: Possessing eminence, elevation, dignity, etc.; above whatever is low, mean, degrading, or dishonorable; magnanimous; as, a noble nature or action; a noble heart.

gross.def: Great; large; bulky; fat; of huge size; excessively large.

texas.def: A structure on the hurricane deck of a steamer, containing the pilot house, officers' cabins, etc.

print.def: To fix or impress, as a stamp, mark, character, idea, etc., into or upon something.

bills.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bill; A beak, as of a bird, or sometimes of a turtle or other animal.

sauce.def: A composition of condiments and appetizing ingredients eaten with food as a relish; especially, a dressing for meat or fish or for puddings; as, mint sauce; sweet sauce, etc.

grass.def: Popularly: Herbage; the plants which constitute the food of cattle and other beasts; pasture.

cheat.def: An act of deception or fraud; that which is the means of fraud or deception; a fraud; a trick; imposition; imposture.

lewis.def: An iron dovetailed tenon, made in sections, which can be fitted into a dovetail mortise; , etc.

steel.def: A variety of iron intermediate in composition and properties between wrought iron and cast iron , and consisting of an alloy of iron with an iron carbide.

burns.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of burn; To consume with fire; to reduce to ashes by the action of heat or fire; : as, to burn up wood.

cabin.def: A cottage or small house; a hut.

sheep.def: (Zoöl.) Any one of several species of ruminants of the genus Ovis, native of the higher mountains of both hemispheres, but most numerous in Asia.

brand.def: A burning piece of wood; or a stick or piece of wood partly burnt, whether burning or after the fire is extinct.

virus.def: An infective agent consisting of nucleic acid in a protein coat, able to multiply in host cells.

plain.def: To lament; to bewail; to complain.

robot.def: A machine capable of carrying out a complex series of actions automatically.

walks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of walk; To move along on foot; to advance by steps; to go on at a moderate pace; specifically, of two-legged creatures, to proceed at a slower or faster rate, but without running, or lifting one foot entirely before the other touches the ground.

purse.def: A small bag or pouch, the opening of which is made to draw together closely, used to carry money in; by extension, any receptacle for money carried on the person; a wallet; a pocketbook; a portemonnaie.

cells.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of cell; A very small and close apartment, as in a prison or in a monastery or convent; the hut of a hermit.

teams.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of team; A group of young animals, especially of young ducks; a brood; a litter.

tribe.def: A family, race, or series of generations, descending from the same progenitor, and kept distinct, as in the case of the twelve tribes of Israel, descended from the twelve sons of Jacob.

equal.def: Agreeing in quantity, size, quality, degree, value, etc.; having the same magnitude, the same value, the same degree, etc.; , degree, quantity, and intensity, and to any subject which admits of them; neither inferior nor superior, greater nor less, better nor worse; corresponding; alike; as, equal quantities of land, water, etc.

chill.def: A moderate but disagreeable degree of cold; a disagreeable sensation of coolness, accompanied with shivering.

nerve.def: One of the whitish and elastic bundles of fibers, with the accompanying tissues, which transmit nervous impulses between nerve centers and various parts of the animal body.

stake.def: A piece of wood, usually long and slender, pointed at one end so as to be easily driven into the ground as a support or stay; as, a stake to support vines, fences, hedges, etc.

units.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of unit; A single thing or person; 2.

seats.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of seat; The place or thing upon which one sits; hence; anything made to be sat in or upon, as a chair, bench, stool, saddle, or the like.

thick.def: Measuring in the third dimension other than length and breadth, or in general dimension other than length; ; as, a timber seven inches thick.

sport.def: That which diverts, and makes mirth; pastime; amusement.

basic.def: Relating to a base; performing the office of a base in a salt.

cliff.def: A high, steep rock; a precipice.

raped.def: Past tense or past participle of rape; Fruit, as grapes, plucked from the cluster.

forth.def: Forward; onward in time, place, or order; in advance from a given point; on to end; as, from that day forth; one, two, three, and so forth.

fetch.def: To bear toward the person speaking, or the person or thing from whose point of view the action is contemplated; to go and bring; to get.

banks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bank; A bench; a high seat, or seat of distinction or judgment; a tribunal or court.

guilt.def: The criminality and consequent exposure to punishment resulting from willful disobedience of law, or from morally wrong action; teh state of one who has broken a moral or political law; crime; criminality; offense against right.

blown.def: Swollen; inflated; distended; puffed up, as cattle when gorged with green food which develops gas.

booth.def: A house or shed built of boards, boughs, or other slight materials, for temporary occupation.

trunk.def: The stem, or body, of a tree, apart from its limbs and roots; the main stem, without the branches; stock; stalk.

drank.def: of Drink; Wild oats, or darnel grass.

boxes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of box; A tree or shrub, flourishing in different parts of the world.

goods.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of good; Possessing desirable qualities; adapted to answer the end designed; promoting success, welfare, or happiness; serviceable; useful; fit; excellent; admirable; commendable; not bad, corrupt, evil, noxious, offensive, or troublesome, etc.

salad.def: A cold dish of various mixtures of raw or cooked vegetables, seasoned with oil or dressing.

loyal.def: Faithful to law; upholding the lawful authority; faithful and true to the lawful government; faithful to the prince or sovereign to whom one is subject; unswerving in allegiance.

mouse.def: (Zoöl.) Any one of numerous species of small rodents belonging to the genus Mus and various related genera of the family Muridæ.
