hills.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of hill; A natural elevation of land, or a mass of earth rising above the common level of the surrounding land; an eminence less than a mountain.

frame.def: (Arch; & Engin.) To construct by fitting and uniting the several parts of the skeleton of any structure; specifically, in woodwork, to put together by cutting parts of one member to fit parts of another.

habit.def: The usual condition or state of a person or thing, either natural or acquired, regarded as something had, possessed, and firmly retained; as, a religious habit; his habit is morose; elms have a spreading habit; esp., physical temperament or constitution; as, a full habit of body.

strip.def: To deprive; to bereave; to make destitute; to plunder; especially, to deprive of a covering; to skin; to peel; as, to strip a man of his possession, his rights, his privileges, his reputation; to strip one of his clothes; to strip a beast of his skin; to strip a tree of its bark.

belly.def: That part of the human body which extends downward from the breast to the thighs, and contains the bowels, or intestines; the abdomen.

hopes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of hop; To move by successive leaps, as toads do; to spring or jump on one foot; to skip, as birds do.

fence.def: That which fends off attack or danger; a defense; a protection; a cover; security; shield.

limit.def: That which terminates, circumscribes, restrains, or confines; the bound, border, or edge; the utmost extent; as, the limit of a walk, of a town, of a country; the limits of human knowledge or endeavor.

gifts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of gift; Anything given; anything voluntarily transferred by one person to another without compensation; a present; an offering.

greek.def: Of or pertaining to Greece or the Greeks; Grecian.

hoped.def: Past tense or past participle of hope; A sloping plain between mountain ridges.

wives.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of wive; To marry, as a man; to take a wife.

bells.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bell; A hollow metallic vessel, usually shaped somewhat like a cup with a flaring mouth, containing a clapper or tongue, and giving forth a ringing sound on being struck.

pulse.def: Leguminous plants, or their seeds, as beans, pease, etc.

cloud.def: A collection of visible vapor, or watery particles, susponded in the upper atmosphere.

pitch.def: A thick, black, lustrous, and sticky substance obtained by boiling down tar.

holds.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of hold; The whole interior portion of a vessel below the lower deck, in which the cargo is stowed.

jacob.def: A Hebrew patriarch , who in a vision saw a ladder reaching up to heaven ;.

charm.def: A melody; a song; [Obs.] With charm of earliest birds.

apply.def: To lay or place; to put or adjust ; ; as, to apply the hand to the breast; to apply medicaments to a diseased part of the body.

fools.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of fool; A compound of gooseberries scalded and crushed, with cream;.

sales.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of sal; An East Indian timber tree , much used for building purposes.

fifty.def: Five times ten; as, fifty men.

clown.def: A man of coarse nature and manners; an awkward fellow; an illbred person; a boor.

minor.def: Inferior in bulk, degree, importance, etc.; less; smaller; of little account; as, minor divisions of a body.

chaos.def: An empty, immeasurable space; a yawning chasm.

angle.def: The inclosed space near the point where two lines; a corner; a nook.

dates.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of date; The fruit of the date palm; also, the date palm itself.

cared.def: Past tense or past participle of care; A burdensome sense of responsibility; trouble caused by onerous duties; anxiety; concern; solicitude.

scale.def: The dish of a balance; hence, the balance itself; an instrument or machine for weighing; as, to turn the scale;.

beats.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of beat; To strike repeatedly; to lay repeated blows upon; as, to beat one's breast; to beat iron so as to shape it; to beat grain, in order to force out the seeds; to beat eggs and sugar; to beat a drum.

bombs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bomb; A great noise; a hollow sound.

shark.def: (Zoöl.) Any one of numerous species of elasmobranch fishes of the order Plagiostomi, found in all seas.

sneak.def: To creep or steal privately; to come or go meanly, as a person afraid or ashamed to be seen; as, to sneak away from company.

shell.def: A hard outside covering, as of a fruit or an animal.

drill.def: To pierce or bore with a drill, or a with a drill; to perforate; as, to drill a hole into a rock; to drill a piece of metal.

liver.def: One who, or that which, lives.

moron.def: A person whose intellectual development proceeds normally up to about the eighth year of age and is then arrested so that there is little or no further development.

latin.def: Of or pertaining to Latium, or to the Latins, a people of Latium; Roman; as, the Latin language.

sandy.def: Consisting of, abounding with, or resembling, sand; full of sand; covered or sprinkled with sand; as, a sandy desert, road, or soil.

album.def: A white tablet on which anything was inscribed, as a list of names, etc.

alley.def: A narrow passage; especially a walk or passage in a garden or park, bordered by rows of trees or bushes; a bordered way.

penis.def: The male member, or organ of generation.

alibi.def: The plea or mode of defense under which a person on trial for a crime proves or attempts to prove that he was in another place when the alleged act was committed; as, to set up an alibi; to prove an alibi.

blade.def: Properly, the leaf, or flat part of the leaf, of any plant, especially of gramineous plants.

alpha.def: The first letter in the Greek alphabet, answering to A, and hence used to denote the beginning.

widow.def: A woman who has lost her husband by death, and has not married again; one living bereaved of a husband.

moral.def: Relating to duty or obligation; pertaining to those intentions and actions of which right and wrong, virtue and vice, are predicated, or to the rules by which such intentions and actions ought to be directed; relating to the practice, manners, or conduct of men as social beings in relation to each other, as respects right and wrong, so far as they are properly subject to rules.

award.def: To give by sentence or judicial determination; to assign or apportion, after careful regard to the nature of the case; to adjudge; as, the arbitrators awarded damages to the complainant.

grief.def: Pain of mind on account of something in the past; mental suffering arising from any cause, as misfortune, loss of friends, misconduct of one's self or others, etc.; sorrow; sadness.

tools.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of tool; An instrument such as a hammer, saw, plane, file, and the like, used in the manual arts, to facilitate mechanical operations; any instrument used by a craftsman or laborer at his work; an implement; as, the tools of a joiner, smith, shoe-maker, etc.; also, a cutter, chisel, or other part of an instrument or machine that dresses work.

novel.def: Of recent origin or introduction; not ancient; new; hence, out of the ordinary course; unusual; strange; surprising.

opera.def: A drama, either tragic or comic, of which music forms an essential part; a drama wholly or mostly sung, consisting of recitative, arials, choruses, duets, trios, etc., with orchestral accompaniment, preludes, and interludes, together with appropriate costumes, scenery, and action; a lyric drama.

brief.def: Short in duration; How brief the life of man.

twins.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of twin; Being one of two born at a birth; as, a twin brother or sister.

prick.def: That which pricks, penetrates, or punctures; a sharp and slender thing; a pointed instrument; a goad; a spur, etc.; a point; a skewer.

forms.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of form; A suffix used to denote in the form or shape of, resembling, etc.; as, valiform; oviform.

votes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of vote; An ardent wish or desire; a vow; a prayer.

abuse.def: To put to a wrong use; to misapply; to misuse; to put to a bad use; to use for a wrong purpose or end; to pervert; as, to abuse inherited gold; to make an excessive use of; as, to abuse one's authority.

elder.def: Older; more aged, or existing longer.

beard.def: The hair that grows on the chin, lips, and adjacent parts of the human face, chiefly of male adults.

diana.def: The daughter of Jupiter and Latona; a virgin goddess who presided over hunting, chastity, and marriage;.

areas.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of area; Any plane surface, as of the floor of a room or church, or of the ground within an inclosure; an open space in a building.

burnt.def: Consumed with, or as with, fire; scorched or dried, as with fire or heat; baked or hardened in the fire or the sun.

upper.def: Being further up, literally or figuratively; higher in place, position, rank, dignity, or the like; superior; as, the upper lip; the upper side of a thing; the upper house of a legislature.

lemon.def: A yellow, oval citrus fruit with thick skin and fragrant, sour juice.

fraud.def: Deception deliberately practiced with a view to gaining an unlawful or unfair advantage; artifice by which the right or interest of another is injured; injurious stratagem; deceit; trick.

beans.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bean; A name given to the seed of certain leguminous herbs, chiefly of the genera Faba, Phaseolus, and Dolichos; also, to the herbs.

pages.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of page; A serving boy; formerly, a youth attending a person of high degree, especially at courts, as a position of honor and education; now commonly, in England, a youth employed for doin errands, waiting on the door, and similar service in households; in the United States, a boy emploed to wait upon the members of a legislative body.

tense.def: One of the forms which a verb takes by inflection or by adding auxiliary words, so as to indicate the time of the action or event signified; the modification which verbs undergo for the indication of time.

motor.def: One who, or that which, imparts motion; a source of mechanical power.

bears.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bear; To support or sustain; to hold up.

steak.def: A high-quality beef cut taken from the hindquarters of the animal, typically grilled or fried.

tooth.def: One of the hard, bony appendages which are borne on the jaws, or on other bones in the walls of the mouth or pharynx of most vertebrates, and which usually aid in the prehension and mastication of food.

cable.def: A large, strong rope or chain, of considerable length, used to retain a vessel at anchor, and for other purposes.

sends.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of send; To cause to go in any manner; to dispatch; to commission or direct to go; as, to send a messenger.

slide.def: To move along the surface of any body by slipping, or without walking or rolling; to slip; to glide; as, snow slides down the mountain's side.

roads.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of road; A journey, or stage of a journey.

entry.def: The act of entering or passing into or upon; entrance; ingress; hence, beginnings or first attempts; as, the entry of a person into a house or city; the entry of a river into the sea; the entry of air into the blood; an entry upon an undertaking.

mount.def: A mass of earth, or earth and rock, rising considerably above the common surface of the surrounding land; a mountain; a high hill; , when put before a proper name; as, Mount Washington; otherwise, chiefly in poetry.

pound.def: To strike repeatedly with some heavy instrument; to beat.

rifle.def: To seize and bear away by force; to snatch away; to carry off.

brick.def: A block or clay tempered with water, sand, etc., molded into a regular form, usually rectangular, and sun-dried, or burnt in a kiln, or in a heap or stack called a clamp.

brush.def: An instrument composed of bristles, or other like material, set in a suitable back or handle, as of wood, bone, or ivory, and used for various purposes, as in removing dust from clothes, laying on colors, etc.

delay.def: A putting off or deferring; procrastination; lingering inactivity; stop; detention; hindrance.

baker.def: One whose business it is to bake bread, biscuit, etc.

badge.def: A distinctive mark, token, sign, or cognizance, worn on the person; as, the badge of a society; the badge of a policeman.

labor.def: Physical toil or bodily exertion, especially when fatiguing, irksome, or unavoidable, in distinction from sportive exercise; hard, muscular effort directed to some useful end, as agriculture, manufactures, and like; servile toil; exertion; work.

eagle.def: (Zoöl.) Any large, rapacious bird of the Falcon family, esp.

basis.def: The foundation of anything; that on which a thing rests.

twist.def: To contort; to writhe; to complicate; to crook spirally; to convolve.

kings.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of king; A Chinese musical instrument, consisting of resonant stones or metal plates, arranged according to their tones in a frame of wood, and struck with a hammer.

inner.def: Further in; interior; internal; not outward; as, an spirit or its phenomena.

cents.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of cent; A hundred; as, ten per cent, the proportion of ten parts in a hundred.

patch.def: A piece of cloth, or other suitable material, sewed or otherwise fixed upon a garment to repair or strengthen it, esp.

drops.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of drop; The quantity of fluid which falls in one small spherical mass; a liquid globule; a minim; hence, also, the smallest easily measured portion of a fluid; a small quantity; as, a drop of water.

fires.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of fir; A genus of coniferous trees, often of large size and elegant shape, some of them valued for their timber and others for their resin.

humor.def: Moisture, especially, the moisture or fluid of animal bodies, as the chyle, lymph, etc.; as, the humors of the eye, etc.

rocky.def: Full of, or abounding in, rocks; consisting of rocks; as, a rocky mountain; a rocky shore.

added.def: Past tense or past participle of add; To give by way of increased possession ; to bestow.

amber.def: A yellowish translucent resin resembling copal, found as a fossil in alluvial soils, with beds of lignite, or on the seashore in many places.

owned.def: Past tense or past participle of own; To grant; to acknowledge; to admit to be true; to confess; to recognize in a particular character; as, we own that we have forfeited your love.

sorts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of sort; Chance; lot; destiny; [Obs.] By aventure, or sort, or cas [chance].

booze.def: To drink greedily or immoderately, esp.

vodka.def: A Russian drink distilled from rye.

solar.def: A loft or upper chamber; a garret room.

yards.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of yard; A rod; a stick; a staff; [Obs.] P.

wears.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of wear; Same as Weir; To cause to go about, as a vessel, by putting the helm up, instead of alee as in tacking, so that the vessel's bow is turned away from, and her stern is presented to, the wind, and, as she turns still farther, her sails fill on the other side; to veer.

phase.def: That which is exhibited to the eye; the appearance which anything manifests, especially any one among different and varying appearances of the same object.

fleet.def: To sail; to float; [Obs.] And in frail wood on Adrian Gulf doth fleet.

irish.def: Of or pertaining to Ireland or to its inhabitants; produced in Ireland.

acted.def: Past tense or past participle of act; That which is done or doing; the exercise of power, or the effect, of which power exerted is the cause; a performance; a deed.

smash.def: To break in pieces by violence; to dash to pieces; to crush.

yells.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of yell; To cry out, or shriek, with a hideous noise; to cry or scream as with agony or horror.

sober.def: Temperate in the use of spirituous liquors; habitually temperate; as, a sober man.

niece.def: A relative, in general; especially, a descendant, whether male or female; a granddaughter or a grandson.

towel.def: A piece of absorbent cloth or paper used for drying or wiping a body or surface.

daisy.def: A genus of low herbs , belonging to the family Compositæ.

bunny.def: A great collection of ore without any vein coming into it or going out from it.

baron.def: A title or degree of nobility; originally, the possessor of a fief, who had feudal tenants under him; in modern times, in France and Germany, a nobleman next in rank below a count; in England, a nobleman of the lowest grade in the House of Lords, being next below a viscount.

petty.def: Little; trifling; inconsiderable; also, inferior; subordinate; as, a petty fault; a petty prince.

diary.def: A register of daily events or transactions; a daily record; a journal; a blank book dated for the record of daily memoranda; as, a diary of the weather; a physician's diary.

wagon.def: A wheeled carriage; a vehicle on four wheels, and usually drawn by horses; especially, one used for carrying freight or merchandise.

bacon.def: The back and sides of a pig salted and smoked; formerly, the flesh of a pig salted or fresh.

dutch.def: Pertaining to Holland, or to its inhabitants.

click.def: To make a slight, sharp noise , as by gentle striking; to tick.

burst.def: To fly apart or in pieces; of break open; to yield to force or pressure, especially to a sudden and violent exertion of force, or to pressure from within; to explode; as, the boiler had burst; the buds will burst in spring.

sunny.def: Of or pertaining to the sun; proceeding from, or resembling the sun; hence, shining; bright; brilliant; radiant.

sheet.def: In general, a large, broad piece of anything thin, as paper, cloth, etc.; a broad, thin portion of any substance; an expanded superficies.

grows.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of grow; To increase in size by a natural and organic process; to increase in bulk by the gradual assimilation of new matter into the living organism;.

ranch.def: To wrench; to tear; to sprain; to injure by violent straining or contortion.

safer.def: One who or that which performs the action of safe, or comparative form; Free from harm, injury, or risk; untouched or unthreatened by danger or injury; unharmed; unhurt; secure; whole; as, safe from disease; safe from storms; safe from foes.

nails.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of nail; the horny scale of plate of epidermis at the end of the fingers and toes of man and many apes.

ashes.def: The earthy or mineral particles of combustible substances remaining after combustion, as of wood or coal.

boats.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of boat; A small open vessel, or water craft, usually moved by cars or paddles, but often by a sail.

steam.def: The elastic, aëriform fluid into which water is converted when heated to the boiling points; water in the state of vapor.

lungs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of lung; An organ for aërial respiration;.

ideal.def: Existing in idea or thought; conceptional; intellectual; mental; as, ideal knowledge.

spoil.def: To plunder; to strip by violence; to pillage; to rob; ; as, to spoil one of his goods or possession.

lance.def: A weapon of war, consisting of a long shaft or handle and a steel blade or head; a spear carried by horsemen, and often decorated with a small flag; also, a spear or harpoon used by whalers and fishermen.

types.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of type; The mark or impression of something; stamp; impressed sign; emblem.

nanny.def: A diminutive of Ann or Anne, the proper name.

vital.def: Belonging or relating to life, either animal or vegetable; as, vital energies; vital functions; vital actions.

voted.def: Past tense or past participle of vote; An ardent wish or desire; a vow; a prayer.

groom.def: A boy or young man; a waiter; a servant; especially, a man or boy who has charge of horses, or the stable.

drown.def: To be suffocated in water or other fluid; to perish in water.

alike.def: Having resemblance or similitude; similar; without difference.

dough.def: Paste of bread; a soft mass of moistened flour or meal, kneaded or unkneaded, but not yet baked; as, to knead dough.

stink.def: To emit a strong, offensive smell; to send out a disgusting odor.

homer.def: A carrier pigeon remarkable for its ability to return home from a distance.

broad.def: Wide; extend in breadth, or from side to side; ; as, a broad street, a broad table; an inch broad.

puppy.def: (Zoöl.) The young of a canine animal, esp.

taxes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of tax; A charge, especially a pecuniary burden which is imposed by authority.

suite.def: A retinue or company of attendants, as of a distinguished personage; as, the suite of an ambassador.

arrow.def: A missile weapon of offense, slender, pointed, and usually feathered and barbed, to be shot from a bow.

sixth.def: First after the fifth; next in order after the fifth.

error.def: A wandering; a roving or irregular course.

sings.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of sing; To utter sounds with musical inflections or melodious modulations of voice, as fancy may dictate, or according to the notes of a song or tune, or of a given part in a chorus or concerted piece.

react.def: To act or perform a second time; to do over again; as, to react a play; the same scenes were reacted at Rome.

theft.def: The act of stealing; specifically, the felonious taking and removing of personal property, with an intent to deprive the rightful owner of the same; larceny.

harsh.def: Rough; disagreeable; grating; esp.: To the touch."Harsh sand." Boyle.

flame.def: A stream of burning vapor or gas, emitting light and heat; darting or streaming fire; a blaze; a fire.

medal.def: A piece of metal in the form of a coin, struck with a device, and intended to preserve the remembrance of a notable event or an illustrious person, or to serve as a reward.

dated.def: Past tense or past participle of date; The fruit of the date palm; also, the date palm itself.

swell.def: To grow larger; to dilate or extend the exterior surface or dimensions, by matter added within, or by expansion of the inclosed substance; as, the legs swell in dropsy; a bruised part swells; a bladder swells by inflation.

feast.def: A festival; a holiday; a solemn, or more commonly, a joyous, anniversary.

bench.def: A long seat, differing from a stool in its greater length.

scout.def: A swift sailing boat; [Obs.] So we took a scout, very much pleased with the manner and conversation of the passengers.

clubs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of club; A heavy staff of wood, usually tapering, and wielded the hand; a weapon; a cudgel.

vault.def: An arched structure of masonry, forming a ceiling or canopy.

quote.def: To cite, as a passage from some author; to name, repeat, or adduce, as a passage from an author or speaker, by way of authority or illustration; as, to quote a passage from Homer.

satan.def: The grand adversary of man; The Devil, or Prince of darkness; the chief of the fallen angels; the archfiend.

perry.def: A fermented liquor made from pears; pear cider.

rusty.def: Covered or affected with rust; as, a rusty knife or sword; rusty wheat.

fears.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of fear; A variant of Fere, a mate, a companion.

heels.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of heel; To lean or tip to one side, as a ship; as, the ship heels aport; the boat heeled over when the squall struck it.

chess.def: A game played on a chessboard, by two persons, with two differently colored sets of men, sixteen in each set.

cargo.def: The lading or freight of a ship or other vessel; the goods, merchandise, or whatever is conveyed in a vessel or boat; load; freight.

shove.def: To drive along by the direct and continuous application of strength; to push; especially, to push so as to make it move along the surface of another body; as, to shove a boat on the water; to shove a table across the floor.

dings.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of ding; To dash; to throw violently.

tapes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of tap; To strike with a slight or gentle blow; to touch gently; to rap lightly; to pat; as, to tap one with the hand or a cane.

risks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of risk; Hazard; danger; peril; exposure to loss, injury, or destruction.

items.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of item; Also; as an additional article.

rumor.def: A flying or popular report; the common talk; hence, public fame; notoriety.

skirt.def: A garment fastened around the waist and hanging down around the legs, worn by women and girls.

spike.def: A sort of very large nail; also, a piece of pointed iron set with points upward or outward.

whale.def: Any aquatic mammal of the order Cetacea, especially any one of the large species, some of which become nearly one hundred feet long.

villa.def: A country seat; a country or suburban residence of some pretensions to elegance.

comic.def: Relating to comedy, as distinct from tragedy.

faint.def: Lacking strength; weak; languid; inclined to swoon; as, faint with fatigue, hunger, or thirst.

bleed.def: To emit blood; to lose blood; to run with blood, by whatever means; as, the arm bleeds; the wound bled freely; to bleed at the nose.

faced.def: Having a face, or faces; as, smooth-faced, two-faced.

cycle.def: An imaginary circle or orbit in the heavens; one of the celestial spheres.

goose.def: Any large web-footen bird of the subfamily Anserinæ, and belonging to Anser, Branta, Chen, and several allied genera.

spots.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of spot; A mark on a substance or body made by foreign matter; a blot; a place discolored.

sweep.def: To pass a broom across so as to remove loose dirt, dust, etc.; to brush, or rub over, with a broom for the purpose of cleaning; as, to sweep a floor, the street, or a chimney.

risky.def: Attended with risk or danger; hazardous.

filed.def: Past tense or past participle of file; An orderly succession; a line; a row; as: A row of soldiers ranged one behind another; , which designates a row of soldiers standing abreast; a number consisting the depth of a body of troops, which, in the ordinary modern formation, consists of two men, the battalion standing two deep, or in two ranks.

deals.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of deal; A part or portion; a share; hence, an indefinite quantity, degree, or extent, degree, or extent; as, a deal of time and trouble; a deal of cold.

blank.def: Of a white or pale color; without color.

tanks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of tank; A small Indian dry measure, averaging 240 grains in weight; also, a Bombay weight of 72 grains, for pearls.

meets.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of meet; To join, or come in contact with; esp., to come in contact with by approach from an opposite direction; to come upon or against, front to front, as distinguished from contact by following and overtaking.

dummy.def: Silent; mute; noiseless; as a dummy engine.

prior.def: Preceding in the order of time; former; antecedent; anterior; previous; as, a prior discovery; prior obligation; : he lived alone [in the time] prior to his marriage.

organ.def: An instrument or medium by which some important action is performed, or an important end accomplished; as, legislatures, courts, armies, taxgatherers, etc., are organs of government.

asses.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of ass; (Zoöl.) A quadruped of the genus Equus , smaller than the horse, and having a peculiarly harsh bray and long ears.

outer.def: Being on the outside; external; farthest or farther from the interior, from a given station, or from any space or position regarded as a center or starting place; ; as, the outer wall; the outer court or gate; the outer stump in cricket; the outer world.

funds.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of fund; An aggregation or deposit of resources from which supplies are or may be drawn for carrying on any work, or for maintaining existence.

spray.def: A small shoot or branch; a twig.

handy.def: Performed by the hand; [Obs.] To draw up and come to handy strokes.

crawl.def: To move slowly by drawing the body along the ground, as a worm; to move slowly on hands and kness; to creep.

slice.def: A thin, broad piece cut off; as, a slice of bacon; a slice of cheese; a slice of bread.

stiff.def: Not easily bent; not flexible or pliant; not limber or flaccid; rigid; firm; as, stiff wood, paper, joints.

allah.def: The name of the Supreme Being, in use among the Arabs and the Mohammedans generally.

rolls.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of roll; To cause to revolve by turning over and over; to move by turning on an axis; to impel forward by causing to turn over and over on a supporting surface; as, to roll a wheel, a ball, or a barrel.

creep.def: To move along the ground, or on any other surface, on the belly, as a worm or reptile; to move as a child on the hands and knees; to crawl.

backs.def: Among leather dealers, the thickest and stoutest tanned hides.

woody.def: Abounding with wood or woods; as, woody land.

horns.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of horn; A hard, projecting, and usually pointed organ, growing upon the heads of certain animals, esp.

dudes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of dude; A kind of dandy; especially, one characterized by an ultrafashionable style of dress and other affectations.

drake.def: The male of the duck kind.

scent.def: To perceive by the olfactory organs; to smell; as, to scent game, as a hound does.

naive.def: Having native or unaffected simplicity; ingenuous; artless; frank; as, naïve manners; a naïve person; naïve and unsophisticated remarks.

jolly.def: Full of life and mirth; jovial; joyous; merry; mirthful.

winds.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of wind; To turn completely, or with repeated turns; especially, to turn about something fixed; to cause to form convolutions about anything; to coil; to twine; to twist; to wreathe; as, to wind thread on a spool or into a ball.

bonus.def: A premium given for a loan, or for a charter or other privilege granted to a company; as the bank paid a bonus for its charter.

wrist.def: The joint, or the region of the joint, between the hand and the arm; the carpus.

coins.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of coin; A quoin; a corner or external angle; a wegde.

drain.def: To draw off by degrees; to cause to flow gradually out or off; hence, to cause the exhaustion of.

beers.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of beer; A fermented liquor made from any malted grain, but commonly from barley malt, with hops or some other substance to impart a bitter flavor.

thumb.def: The short, thick first digit of the human hand, differing from the other fingers in having but two phalanges; the pollex.

roots.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of root; To turn up the earth with the snout, as swine.

blues.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of blue; Having the color of the clear sky, or a hue resembling it, whether lighter or darker; as, the deep, blue sea; as blue as a sapphire; blue violets.

lobby.def: A passage or hall of communication, especially when large enough to serve also as a waiting room.

clues.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of clue; A ball of thread, yarn, or cord; also, The thread itself.

debts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of debt; That which is due from one person to another, whether money, goods, or services; that which one person is bound to pay to another, or to perform for his benefit; thing owed; obligation; liability.

mates.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of mat; A name given by coppersmiths to an alloy of copper, tin, iron, etc., usually called white metal.

meals.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of meal; A part; a fragment; a portion.

adams.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of adam; The name given in the Bible to the first man, the progenitor of the human race.

erica.def: A genus of shrubby plants, including the heaths, many of them producing beautiful flowers.

hears.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of hear; To perceive by the ear; to apprehend or take cognizance of by the ear; as, to hear sounds; to hear a voice; to hear one call.

fatal.def: Proceeding from, or appointed by, fate or destiny; necessary; inevitable.

roast.def: To cook by exposure to radiant heat before a fire; as, to roast meat on a spit, or in an oven open toward the fire and having reflecting surfaces within; also, to cook in a close oven.

flood.def: A great flow of water; a body of moving water; the flowing stream, as of a river; especially, a body of water, rising, swelling, and overflowing land not usually thus covered; a deluge; a freshet; an inundation.

champ.def: To bite with repeated action of the teeth so as to be heard.

dizzy.def: Having in the head a sensation of whirling, with a tendency to fall; vertiginous; giddy; hence, confused; indistinct.

bully.def: A noisy, blustering fellow, more insolent than courageous; one who is threatening and quarrelsome; an insolent, tyrannical fellow.

pedro.def: The five of trumps in certain varieties of auction pitch.

spill.def: A bit of wood split off; a splinter.

cured.def: Past tense or past participle of cure; Care, heed, or attention; [Obs.] Of study took he most cure and most heed.

snack.def: A small amount of food eaten between meals as a light refreshment.

cheek.def: The side of the face below the eye.

ditch.def: A trench made in the earth by digging, particularly a trench for draining wet land, for guarding or fencing inclosures, or for preventing an approach to a town or fortress.

roars.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of roar; To cry with a full, loud, continued sound.

loads.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of load; A burden; that which is laid on or put in anything for conveyance; that which is borne or sustained; a weight; as, a heavy load.

spite.def: Ill-will or hatred toward another, accompanied with the disposition to irritate, annoy, or thwart; petty malice; grudge; rancor; despite.

rebel.def: Pertaining to rebels or rebellion; acting in revolt; rebellious; as, rebel troops.

reply.def: To make a return in words or writing; to respond; to answer.

orbit.def: The path described by a heavenly body in its periodical revolution around another body; as, the orbit of Jupiter, of the earth, of the moon.

slams.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of slam; To shut with force and a loud noise; to bang; as, he slammed the door.

tales.def: Persons added to a jury, commonly from those in or about the courthouse, to make up any deficiency in the number of jurors regularly summoned, being like, or such as, the latter.

lions.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of lion; (Zoöl.) A large carnivorous feline mammal , found in Southern Asia and in most parts of Africa, distinct varieties occurring in the different countries.

forty.def: Four times ten; thirtynine and one more.

brass.def: An alloy of copper and zinc, in variable proportion, but often containing two parts of copper to one part of zinc.

email.def: Messages distributed by electronic means from one computer user to one or more recipients.

tasty.def: Having a good taste; ; as, a tasty woman.

eager.def: Sharp; sour; acid; [Obs.] "Like eager droppings into milk." Shak.

wells.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of well; An issue of water from the earth; a spring; a fountain.

repay.def: To pay back; to refund; as, to repay money borrowed or advanced.

logic.def: The science or art of exact reasoning, or of pure and formal thought, or of the laws according to which the processes of pure thinking should be conducted; the science of the formation and application of general notions; the science of generalization, judgment, classification, reasoning, and systematic arrangement; correct reasoning.

jeans.def: Hard-wearing trousers made of denim or other cotton fabric, for casual wear.

minus.def: Less; requiring to be subtracted; negative; as, a minus quantity.

ruled.def: Past tense or past participle of rule; That which is prescribed or laid down as a guide for conduct or action; a governing direction for a specific purpose; an authoritative enactment; a regulation; a prescription; a precept; as, the rules of various societies; the rules governing a school; a rule of etiquette or propriety; the rules of cricket.

cough.def: To expel air, or obstructing or irritating matter, from the lungs or air passages, in a noisy and violent manner.

drums.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of drum; An instrument of percussion, consisting either of a hollow cylinder, over each end of which is stretched a piece of skin or vellum, to be beaten with a stick; or of a metallic hemisphere with a single piece of skin to be so beaten; the common instrument for marking time in martial music; one of the pair of tympani in an orchestra, or cavalry band.

cloth.def: A fabric made of fibrous material ; commonly, a woven fabric of cotton, woolen, or linen, adapted to be made into garments; specifically, woolen fabrics, as distinguished from all others.

float.def: Anything which floats or rests on the surface of a fluid, as to sustain weight, or to indicate the height of the surface, or mark the place of, something.

glove.def: A cover for the hand, or for the hand and wrist, with a separate sheath for each finder.

corps.def: The human body, whether living or dead.

piper.def: One who or that which performs the action of pip, or comparative form; A contagious disease of fowls, characterized by hoarseness, discharge from the nostrils and eyes, and an accumulation of mucus in the mouth, forming a "scale" on the tongue.

creek.def: A small inlet or bay, narrower and extending further into the land than a cove; a recess in the shore of the sea, or of a river.

reads.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of read; Rennet; See 3d Reed.

seeds.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of seed; A ripened ovule, consisting of an embryo with one or more integuments, or coverings; as, an apple seed; a currant seed.

armor.def: Defensive arms for the body; any clothing or covering worn to protect one's person in battle.

cakes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of cake; A small mass of dough baked; especially, a thin loaf from unleavened dough; as, an oatmeal cake; johnnycake.

ankle.def: The joint which connects the foot with the leg; the tarsus.

nicer.def: One who or that which performs the action of nice, or comparative form; Foolish; silly; simple; ignorant; also, weak; effeminate.

draft.def: Pertaining to, or used for, drawing or pulling.

asian.def: Of or pertaining to Asia; Asiatic.

quest.def: The act of seeking, or looking after anything; attempt to find or obtain; search; pursuit; as, to rove in quest of game, of a lost child, of property, etc.

spoon.def: An implement consisting of a small shallow oval bowl on a long handle, used for eating or stirring.

swamp.def: Wet, spongy land; soft, low ground saturated with water, but not usually covered with it; marshy ground away from the seashore.

depth.def: The quality of being deep; deepness; perpendicular measurement downward from the surface,or horizontal measurement backward from the front; as, the depth of a river; the depth of a body of troops.

wakes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of wake; The track left by a vessel in the water; by extension, any track; as, the wake of an army.

occur.def: To meet; to clash; [Obs.] The resistance of the bodies they occur with.

stamp.def: To strike beat, or press forcibly with the bottom of the foot, or by thrusting the foot downward.

torch.def: A light or luminary formed of some combustible substance, as of resinous wood; a large candle or flambeau, or a lamp giving a large, flaring flame.

stall.def: A stand; a station; a fixed spot; hence, the stand or place where a horse or an ox kept and fed; the division of a stable, or the compartment, for one horse, ox, or other animal.

mines.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of mine; ; [Obs.] Belonging to me; my.

panel.def: A sunken compartment with raised margins, molded or otherwise, as in ceilings, wainscotings, etc.

smack.def: A small sailing vessel, commonly rigged as a sloop, used chiefly in the coasting and fishing trade.

locks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of lock; A tuft of hair; a flock or small quantity of wool, hay, or other like substance; a tress or ringlet of hair.

choir.def: A band or organized company of singers, especially in church service.

stunt.def: To hinder from growing to the natural size; to prevent the growth of; to stint, to dwarf; as, to stunt a child; to stunt a plant.

hobby.def: A small, strong-winged European falcon , formerly trained for hawking.

hatch.def: To cross with lines in a peculiar manneHatching.

dolls.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of doll; A child's puppet; a toy baby for a little girl.

ruins.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of ruin; The act of falling or tumbling down; fall.

sadly.def: Wearily; heavily; firmly; [Obs.] In go the spears full sadly in arest.

fluid.def: Having particles which easily move and change their relative position without a separation of the mass, and which easily yield to pressure; capable of flowing; liquid or gaseous.

moans.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of moan; To make a low prolonged sound of grief or pain, whether articulate or not; to groan softly and continuously.

picks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of pick; To throw; to pitch; [Obs.] As high as I could pick my lance.

pulls.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of pull; To draw, or attempt to draw, toward one; to draw forcibly.

flush.def: To flow and spread suddenly; to rush; as, blood flushes into the face.

toxic.def: Of or pertaining to poison; poisonous; as, toxic medicines.

sakes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of sake; Final cause; end; purpose of obtaining; cause; motive; reason; interest; concern; account; regard or respect; , for the sake, for his sake, for man's sake, for mercy's sake, and the like; as, to commit crime for the sake of gain; to go abroad for the sake of one's health.

rally.def: To collect, and reduce to order, as troops dispersed or thrown into confusion; to gather again; to reunite.

bloom.def: A blossom; the flower of a plant; an expanded bud; flowers, collectively.

cease.def: To come to an end; to stop; to leave off or give over; to desist; as, the noise ceased "To cease from strife." Prov.

bribe.def: A gift begged; a present; [Obs.] Chaucer.

burke.def: To murder by suffocation, or so as to produce few marks of violence, for the purpose of obtaining a body to be sold for dissection.

lodge.def: A shelter in which one may rest; as: A shed; a rude cabin; a hut; as, an Indian's lodge.

trips.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of trip; To move with light, quick steps; to walk or move lightly; to skip; to move the feet nimbly;.

venus.def: The goddess of beauty and love, that is, beauty or love deified.

olive.def: A small oval fruit with a hard pit and bitter flesh, used for food and oil.

belle.def: A young lady of superior beauty and attractions; a handsome lady, or one who attracts notice in society; a fair lady.

straw.def: To spread or scatter; , and Strow.

diner.def: One who or that which performs the action of din, or comparative form; Loud, confused, harsh noise; a loud, continuous, rattling or clanging sound; clamor; roar.

weigh.def: A corruption of Way, used only in the phrase under weigh.

swiss.def: A native or inhabitant of Switzerland; a Switzer; the people of Switzerland.

topic.def: One of the various general forms of argument employed in probable as distinguished from demonstrative reasoning, `poi , as being the places or sources from which arguments may be derived, or to which they may be referred; also, a prepared form of argument, applicable to a great variety of cases, with a supply of which the ancient rhetoricians and orators provided themselves; a commonplace of argument or oratory.

blond.def: Of a fair color; light-colored; as, blond hair; a blond complexion.

plead.def: To argue in support of a claim, or in defense against the claim of another; to urge reasons for or against a thing; to attempt to persuade one by argument or supplication; to speak by way of persuasion; as, to plead for the life of a criminal; to plead with a judge or with a father.

races.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of race; A game, match, etc., open only to losers in early stages of contests.

kicks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of kick; To strike, thrust, or hit violently with the foot; as, a horse kicks a groom; a man kicks a dog.

barks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bark; To strip the bark from; to peel.

cigar.def: A small roll of tobacco, used for smoking.

seize.def: To fall or rush upon suddenly and lay hold of; to gripe or grasp suddenly; to reach and grasp.

sting.def: (Zoöl.) Any sharp organ of offense and defense, especially when connected with a poison gland, and adapted to inflict a wound by piercing; as the caudal sting of a scorpion.

attic.def: Of or pertaining to Attica, in Greece, or to Athens, its principal city; marked by such qualities as were characteristic of the Athenians; classical; refined.

polly.def: A woman's name; also, a popular name for a parrot.

bands.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of band; A fillet, strap, or any narrow ligament with which a thing is encircled, or fastened, or by which a number of things are tied, bound together, or confined; a fetter.

dried.def: of Day; Also adj.; as, dried apples.

aunty.def: A familiar name for an aunt.

maker.def: One who makes, forms, or molds; a manufacturer; specifically, the Creator.

scarf.def: A length of fabric worn around the neck or head for warmth or decoration.

marsh.def: A tract of soft wet land, commonly covered partially or wholly with water; a fen; a swamp; a morass.

lords.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of lord; A hump-backed person;; [Eng.] Richardson.

tumor.def: A morbid swelling, prominence, or growth, on any part of the body; especially, a growth produced by deposition of new tissue; a neoplasm.

rogue.def: A vagrant; an idle, sturdy beggar; a vagabond; a tramp.

erase.def: To rub or scrape out, as letters or characters written, engraved, or painted; to efface; to expunge; to cross out; as, to erase a word or a name.

canal.def: An artificial channel filled with water and designed for navigation, or for irrigating land, etc.

shade.def: Comparative obscurity owing to interception or interruption of the rays of light; partial darkness caused by the intervention of something between the space contemplated and the source of light.

hence.def: From this place; away; "Or that we hence wend." Chaucer.

rival.def: A person having a common right or privilege with another; a partner.

elite.def: A choice or select body; the flower; as, the élite of society.

shelf.def: A flat tablet or ledge of any material set horizontally at a distance from the floor, to hold objects of use or ornament.

chart.def: A sheet of paper, pasteboard, or the like, on which information is exhibited, esp.

globe.def: A round or spherical body, solid or hollow; a body whose surface is in every part equidistant from the center; a ball; a sphere.

breed.def: To produce as offspring; to bring forth; to bear; to procreate; to generate; to beget; to hatch.

adore.def: To worship with profound reverence; to pay divine honors to; to honor as deity or as divine.

pasta.def: A dish originally from Italy consisting of dough made from durum wheat and water, extruded into shapes.

delta.def: A tract of land shaped like the letter delta (as, the delta of the Ganges, of the Nile, or of the Mississippi.

honks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of honk; The cry of a wild goose; "ing, n.

codes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of cod; A husk; a pod; as, a peascod.

dolly.def: A contrivance, turning on a vertical axis by a handle or winch, and giving a circular motion to the ore to be washed; a stirrer.

gypsy.def: One of a vagabond race, whose tribes, coming originally from India, entered Europe in 14th or 15th centry, and are now scattered over Turkey, Russia, Hungary, Spain, England, etc., living by theft, fortune telling, horsejockeying, tinkering, etc.

bonds.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bond; That which binds, ties, fastens,or confines, or by which anything is fastened or bound, as a cord, chain, etc.; a band; a ligament; a shackle or a manacle.

veins.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of vein; One of the vessels which carry blood, either venous or arterial, to the heart.

ridge.def: The back, or top of the back; a crest.

razor.def: A keen-edged knife of peculiar shape, used in shaving the hair from the face or the head.

wires.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of wire; A thread or slender rod of metal; a metallic substance formed to an even thread by being passed between grooved rollers, or drawn through holes in a plate of steel.

views.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of view; The act of seeing or beholding; sight; look; survey; examination by the eye; inspection.

realm.def: A royal jurisdiction or domain; a region which is under the dominion of a king; a kingdom.

missy.def: ; An affectionate, or contemptuous, form of miss; a young girl; a miss.

altar.def: A raised structure on which sacrifices are offered or incense burned to a deity.

jelly.def: Anything brought to a gelatinous condition; a viscous, translucent substance in a condition between liquid and solid; a stiffened solution of gelatin, gum, or the like.

pains.def: Labor; toilsome effort; care or trouble taken; , but used with a singular or plural verb, commonly the former.

donor.def: One who gives or bestows; one who confers anything gratuitously; a benefactor.

cocks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of cock; The male of birds, particulary of gallinaceous or domestic fowls.

refer.def: To carry or send back; [Obs.] Chaucer.

fails.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of fail; To be wanting; to fall short; to be or become deficient in any measure or degree up to total absence; to cease to be furnished in the usual or expected manner, or to be altogether cut off from supply; to be lacking; as, streams fail; crops fail.

karma.def: One's acts considered as fixing one's lot in the future existence.

layer.def: One who, or that which, lays.

devon.def: One of a breed of hardy cattle originating in the country of Devon, England.

ducks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of duck; A pet; a darling; Shak.

ropes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of rope; A large, stout cord, usually one not less than an inch in circumference, made of strands twisted or braided together.

adopt.def: To take by choice into relationship, as, child, heir, friend, citizen, etc.

worms.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of worm; A creeping or a crawling animal of any kind or size, as a serpent, caterpillar, snail, or the like.

moses.def: A large flatboat, used in the West Indies for taking freight from shore to ship.

frost.def: The act of freezing; ; congelation of fluids.

blunt.def: Having a thick edge or point, as an instrument; dull; not sharp.

niles.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of nil; Will not; [Obs.] Chaucer.

paths.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of path; A trodden way; a footway; The dewy paths of meadows we will tread.

yacht.def: A light and elegantly furnished vessel, used either for private parties of pleasure, or as a vessel of state to convey distinguished persons from one place to another; a seagoing vessel used only for pleasure trips, racing, etc.

tease.def: To comb or card, as wool or flax.

rider.def: One who, or that which, rides.

rises.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of ris; A bough or branch; a twig.

texts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of text; A discourse or composition on which a note or commentary is written; the original words of an author, in distinction from a paraphrase, annotation, or commentary.

chili.def: A kind of red pepper; [Written also chilli and chile.].

untie.def: To loosen, as something interlaced or knotted; to disengage the parts of; as, to untie a knot.

whack.def: To strike; to beat; to give a heavy or resounding blow to; to thrash; to make with whacks.

noisy.def: Making a noise, esp; a loud sound; clamorous; vociferous; turbulent; boisterous; as, the noisy crowd.

waits.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of wait; To watch; to observe; to take notice.

scars.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of scar; A mark in the skin or flesh of an animal, made by a wound or ulcer, and remaining after the wound or ulcer is healed; a cicatrix; a mark left by a previous injury; a blemish; a disfigurement.

lasts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of last; of Last, to endure, contracted from lasteth.

beads.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bead; A prayer; [Obs.] 2.

windy.def: Consisting of wind; accompanied or characterized by wind; exposed to wind.

ryder.def: A clause added to a document; a rider.

ewing.def: Present participle or gerund of ew; A yew; [Obs.] Chaucer.

derby.def: A race for three-old horses, run annually at Epsom , for the Derby stakes.

heave.def: To cause to move upward or onward by a lifting effort; to lift; to raise; to hoist; ; as, the wave heaved the boat on land.

dandy.def: One who affects special finery or gives undue attention to dress; a fop; a coxcomb.

lamps.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of lamp; A thin plate or lamina; [Obs.] Chaucer.

mammy.def: A child's name for mamma, mother.

maths.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of math; A mowing, or that which is gathered by mowing; ; as, an aftermath.

laden.def: Loaded; freighted; burdened; as, a laden vessel; a laden heart.

moons.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of moon; The celestial orb which revolves round the earth; the satellite of the earth; a secondary planet, whose light, borrowed from the sun, is reflected to the earth, and serves to dispel the darkness of night.

wails.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of wail; To choose; to select; [Obs.] "Wailed wine and meats." Henryson.

heath.def: A low shrub , with minute evergreen leaves, and handsome clusters of pink flowers.

germs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of germ; That which is to develop a new individual; as, the germ of a fetus, of a plant or flower, and the like; the earliest form under which an organism appears.

elves.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of elve; An old form of Elf.

clamp.def: Something rigid that holds fast or binds things together; a piece of wood or metal, used to hold two or more pieces together.

poets.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of poet; One skilled in making poetry; one who has a particular genius for metrical composition; the author of a poem; an imaginative thinker or writer.

faded.def: That has lost freshness, color, or brightness; grown dim.

rural.def: Of or pertaining to the country, as distinguished from a city or town; living in the country; suitable for, or resembling, the country; rustic; as, rural scenes; a rural prospect.

usher.def: An officer or servant who has the care of the door of a court, hall, chamber, or the like; hence, an officer whose business it is to introduce strangers, or to walk before a person of rank.

hindi.def: The name given by Europeans to that form of the Hindustani language which is chiefly spoken by native Hindoos.

merge.def: To cause to be swallowed up; to immerse; to sink; to absorb.

blaze.def: A stream of gas or vapor emitting light and heat in the process of combustion; a bright flame.

fiber.def: One of the delicate, threadlike portions of which the tissues of plants and animals are in part constituted; as, the fiber of flax or of muscle.

bosom.def: The breast of a human being; the part, between the arms, to which anything is pressed when embraced by them.

shred.def: A long, narrow piece cut or torn off; a strip.

dread.def: To fear in a great degree; to regard, or look forward to, with terrific apprehension.

abyss.def: A bottomless or unfathomed depth, gulf, or chasm; hence, any deep, immeasurable, and, specifically, hell, or the bottomless pit.

rouge.def: red; [R.] Rouge et noir ( Etym: [F., red and black], a game at cards in which persons play against the owner of the bank; , upon which the stakes are deposited.

corny.def: Strong, stiff, or hard, like a horn; resembling horn.

havoc.def: Wide and general destruction; devastation; waste.

abide.def: To wait; to pause; to delay.

clink.def: To cause to give out a slight, sharp, tinkling, sound, as by striking metallic or other sonorous bodies together.

grail.def: A book of offices in the Roman Catholic Church; a gradual.

slade.def: A little dell or valley; a flat piece of low, moist ground.

weeds.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of weed; A garment; clothing; especially, an upper or outer garment.

decoy.def: To lead into danger by artifice; to lure into a net or snare; to entrap; to insnare; to allure; to entice; as, to decoy troops into an ambush; to decoy ducks into a net.

vivid.def: True to the life; exhibiting the appearance of life or freshness; animated; spirited; bright; strong; intense; as, vivid colors.

shaky.def: Shaking or trembling; as, a shaky spot in a marsh; a shaky hand.

goody.def: A bonbon, cake, or the like;.

noose.def: A running knot, or loop, which binds the closer the more it is drawn.

index.def: That which points out; that which shows, indicates, manifests, or discloses.

blush.def: To become suffused with red in the cheeks, as from a sense of shame, modesty, or confusion; to become red from such cause, as the cheeks or face.

array.def: Order; a regular and imposing arrangement; disposition in regular lines; hence, order of battle; as, drawn up in battle array.

maple.def: A tree of the genus Acer, including about fifty species.

pools.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of pool; A small and rather deep collection of fresh water, as one supplied by a spring, or occurring in the course of a stream; a reservoir for water; as, the pools of Solomon.

linen.def: ] Made of linen; as, linen cloth; a linen stocking.

slime.def: Soft, moist earth or clay, having an adhesive quality; viscous mud.

darts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of dart; A pointed missile weapon, intended to be thrown by the hand; a short lance; a javelin; hence, any sharp-pointed missile weapon, as an arrow.

lured.def: Past tense or past participle of lure; A contrivance somewhat resembling a bird, and often baited with raw meat;.

flaws.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of flaw; A crack or breach; a gap or fissure; a defect of continuity or cohesion; as, a flaw in a knife or a vase.

clash.def: To make a noise by striking against something; to dash noisily together.

theta.def: A letter of the Greek alphabet corresponding to th in English; , from being used by the judges on their ballots in passing condemnation on a prisoner, it being the first letter of the Greek qa`natos, death.

dixie.def: A colloquial name for the Southern portion of the United States, esp.

fudge.def: A made-up story; stuff; nonsense; humbug;.

ivory.def: The hard, white, opaque, fine-grained substance constituting the tusks of the elephant.

trend.def: To have a particular direction; to run; to stretch; to tend; as, the shore of the sea trends to the southwest.

chump.def: A short, thick, heavy piece of wood.

cyber.def: Relating to or characteristic of the culture of computers, information technology, and virtual reality.

aging.def: Present participle or gerund of age; The whole duration of a being, whether animal, vegetable, or other kind; lifetime.

mango.def: A fleshy yellowish-red tropical fruit that is eaten ripe or used green for pickles.

decay.def: To pass gradually from a sound, prosperous, or perfect state, to one of imperfection, adversity, or dissolution; to waste away; to decline; to fail; to become weak, corrupt, or disintegrated; to rot; to perish; as, a tree decays; fortunes decay; hopes decay.

welsh.def: Of or pertaining to Wales, or its inhabitants.

lifts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of lift; The sky; the atmosphere; the firmament.

amuse.def: To occupy or engage the attention of; to lose in deep thought; to absorb; also, to distract; to bewilder.

lorry.def: A small cart or wagon, as those used on the tramways in mines to carry coal or rubbish; also, a barrow or truck for shifting baggage, as at railway stations.

sacks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of sack; A anme formerly given to various dry Spanish wines.

joins.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of join; To bring together, literally or figuratively; to place in contact; to connect; to couple; to unite; to combine; to associate; to add; to append.

jacks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of jack; A large tree, the Artocarpus integrifolia, common in the East Indies, closely allied to the breadfruit, from which it differs in having its leaves entire.

thump.def: The sound made by the sudden fall or blow of a heavy body, as of a hammer, or the like.

weave.def: To unite, as threads of any kind, in such a manner as to form a texture; to entwine or interlace into a fabric; as, to weave wool, silk, etc.; hence, to unite by close connection or intermixture; to unite intimately.

budge.def: To move off; to stir; to walk away.

diver.def: One who, or that which, dives.

serge.def: A woolen twilled stuff, much used as material for clothing for both sexes.

relic.def: That which remains; that which is left after loss or decay; a remaining portion; a remnant.

spade.def: (Zoöl.) A hart or stag three years old.

ratio.def: The relation which one quantity or magnitude has to another of the same kind.

brats.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of brat; A coarse garnment or cloak; also, coarse clothing, in general.

leaks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of leak; A crack, crevice, fissure, or hole which admits water or other fluid, or lets it escape; as, a leak in a roof; a leak in a boat; a leak in a gas pipe.

cupid.def: The god of love, son of Venus; usually represented as a naked, winged boy with bow and arrow.

scalp.def: A bed of oysters or mussels.

misty.def: Accompained with mist; characterized by the presence of mist; obscured by, or overspread with, mist; as, misty weather; misty mountains; a misty atmosphere.

tents.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of tent; A kind of wine of a deep red color, chiefly from Galicia or Malaga in Spain; , and tinta.

hedge.def: A thicket of bushes, usually thorn bushes; especially, such a thicket planted as a fence between any two portions of land; and also any sort of shrubbery, as evergreens, planted in a line or as a fence; particularly, such a thicket planted round a field to fence it, or in rows to separate the parts of a garden.

viper.def: (Zoöl.) Any one of numerous species of Old World venomous makes belonging to Vipera, Clotho, Daboia, and other genera of the family Viperidæ.

witty.def: Possessed of wit; knowing; wise; skillful; judicious; clever; cunning.

abbot.def: The superior or head of an abbey.

bolts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bolt; A shaft or missile intended to be shot from a crossbow or catapult, esp.

guild.def: An association of men belonging to the same class, or engaged in kindred pursuits, formed for mutual aid and protection; a business fraternity or corporation; as, the Stationers' Guild; the Ironmongers' Guild.

zebra.def: Either one of two species of South African wild horses remarkable for having the body white or yellowish white, and conspicuously marked with dark brown or brackish bands.

rails.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of rail; An outer cloak or covering; a neckerchief for women.

growl.def: To utter a deep guttural sound, sa an angry dog; to give forth an angry, grumbling sound.

users.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of user; One who uses; Shak.

skins.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of skin; The external membranous integument of an animal.

spree.def: A merry frolic; especially, a drinking frolic; a carousal.

yates.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of yate; A gate; See 1st Gate.

stale.def: The stock or handle of anything; as, the stale of a rake.

boner.def: One who or that which performs the action of bon, or comparative form; Good; valid as security for something.

spank.def: To strike, as the breech, with the open hand; to slap.

baton.def: A staff or truncheon, used for various purposes; as, the baton of a field marshal; the baton of a conductor in musical performances.

kinky.def: Full of kinks; liable to kink or curl; as, kinky hair.

quits.def: See the Note under Quit, a.

hosts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of host; The consecrated wafer, believed to be the body of Christ, which in the Mass is offered as a sacrifice; also, the bread before consecration.

dumps.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of dump; A thick, ill-shapen piece; a clumsy leaden counter used by boys in playing chuck farthing.

fumes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of fum; To play upon a fiddle; [Obs.] Follow me, and fum as you go.

glued.def: Past tense or past participle of glue; A hard brittle brownish gelatin, obtained by boiling to a jelly the skins, hoofs, etc., of animals.

forum.def: A market place or public place in Rome, where causes were judicially tried, and orations delivered to the people.

crest.def: A tuft, or other excrescence or natural ornament, growing on animal's head; the comb of a cock; the swelling on the head of a serpent; the lengthened feathers of the crown or nape of bird, etc.

peers.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of peer; To come in sight; to appear.

pluto.def: The son of Saturn and Rhea, brother of Jupiter and Neptune; the dark and gloomy god of the Lower World.

watts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of watt; A unit of power or activity equal to 107 C.G.S.

lowly.def: Not high; not elevated in place; low.

hades.def: The nether world ; the invisible world; the grave.

cramp.def: That which confines or contracts; a restraint; a shakle; a hindrance.

moist.def: Moderately wet; damp; humid; not dry; as, a moist atmosphere or air.

folly.def: The state of being foolish; want of good sense; levity, weakness, or derangement of mind.

chord.def: The string of a musical instrument.
