wacky.def: A soft, earthy, dark-colored rock or clay derived from the alteration of basalt.

adieu.def: Good-by; farewell; an expression of kind wishes at parting.

sinks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of sink; To fall by, or as by, the force of gravity; to descend lower and lower; to decline gradually; to subside; as, a stone sinks in water; waves rise and sink; the sun sinks in the west.

bugle.def: A sort of wild ox; a buffalo.

frown.def: To contract the brow in displeasure, severity, or sternness; to scowl; to put on a stern, grim, or surly look.

quota.def: A proportional part or share; the share or proportion assigned to each in a division.

tidal.def: Of or pertaining to tides; caused by tides; having tides; periodically rising and falling, or following and ebbing; as, tidal waters.

genre.def: A style of painting, sculpture, or other imitative art, which illustrates everyday life and manners.

unfit.def: To make unsuitable or incompetent; to deprive of the strength, skill, or proper qualities for anything; to disable; to incapacitate; to disqualify; as, sickness unfits a man for labor; sin unfits us for the society of holy beings.

fetus.def: The young or embryo of an animal in the womb, or in the egg; often restricted to the later stages in the development of viviparous and oviparous animals, embryo being applied to the earlier stages.

lanes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of lane; Alone [Scot.] His lane, by himself; himself alone.

eater.def: One who, or that which, eats.

rowdy.def: One who engages in rows, or noisy quarrels; a ruffianly fellow.

poses.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of pose; Standing still, with all the feet on the ground; , horse, or other beast.

snuff.def: The part of a candle wick charred by the flame, whether burning or not.

swarm.def: To climb a tree, pole, or the like, by embracing it with the arms and legs alternately.

rowan.def: Rowan tree; Rowan barry, a barry of the rowan tree.

timid.def: Wanting courage to meet danger; easily frightened; timorous; not bold; fearful; shy.

garth.def: A close; a yard; a croft; a garden; as, a cloister garth.

stalk.def: The stem or main axis of a plant; as, a stalk of wheat, rye, or oats; the stalks of maize or hemp.

fours.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of four; One more than three; twice two.

slaps.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of slap; A blow, esp; one given with the open hand, or with something broad.

waved.def: Exhibiting a wavelike form or outline; undulating; intended; wavy; as, waved edge.

spook.def: A spirit; a ghost; an apparition; a hobgoblin.

tombs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of tomb; A pit in which the dead body of a human being is deposited; a grave; a sepulcher.

doses.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of dose; The quantity of medicine given, or prescribed to be taken, at one time.

boast.def: To vaunt one's self; to brag; to say or tell things which are intended to give others a high opinion of one's self or of things belonging to one's self; as, to boast of one's exploits courage, descent, wealth.

snore.def: To breathe with a rough, hoarse, nasal voice in sleep.

sluts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of slut; An untidy woman; a slattern.

firms.def: The principal rafters of a roof, especially a pair of rafters taken together.

griff.def: Grasp; reach; [Obs.] A vein of gold ore within one spade's griff.

coded.def: Past tense or past participle of code; A body of law, sanctioned by legislation, in which the rules of law to be specifically applied by the courts are set forth in systematic form; a compilation of laws by public authority; a digest.

forks.def: Implements with two or more prongs used for lifting food to the mouth or holding it.

snowy.def: White like snow; "So shows a snowy dove trooping with crows." Shak.

audit.def: An audience; a hearing; [Obs.] He appeals to a high audit.

heals.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of heal; To cover, as a roof, with tiles, slate, lead, or the like.

paces.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of pac; A kind of moccasin, having the edges of the sole turned up and sewed to the upper.

slugs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of slug; A drone; a slow, lazy fellow; a sluggard.

jerky.def: Moving by jerks and starts; characterized by abrupt transitions; as, a jerky vehicle; a jerky style.

slows.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of slow; imp; of Slee, to slay.

penal.def: Of or pertaining to punishment, to penalties, or to crimes and offenses; pertaining to criminal jurisprudence: as: Enacting or threatening punishment; as, a penal statue; the penal code.

frail.def: A basket made of rushes, used chiefly for containing figs and raisins.

pints.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of pint; A measure of capacity, equal to half a quart, or four gills,.

urges.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of urge; To press; to push; to drive; to impel; to force onward.

flask.def: A small bottle-shaped vessel for holding fluids; as, a flask of oil or wine.

swain.def: A servant; [Obs.] Him behoves serve himself that has no swain.

typed.def: Past tense or past participle of type; The mark or impression of something; stamp; impressed sign; emblem.

ports.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of port; A dark red or purple astringent wine made in Portugal.

ulcer.def: A solution of continuity in any of the soft parts of the body, discharging purulent matter, found on a surface, especially one of the natural surfaces of the body, and originating generally in a constitutional disorder; a sore discharging pus.

racer.def: One who, or that which, races, or contends in a race; esp., a race horse.

plots.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of plot; A small extent of ground; a plat; as, a garden plot.

vents.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of vent; Sale; opportunity to sell; market.

foggy.def: Filled or abounding with fog, or watery exhalations; misty; as, a foggy atmosphere; a foggy morning.

reins.def: The kidneys; also, the region of the kidneys; the loins.

fussy.def: Making a fuss; disposed to make an unnecessary ado about trifles; overnice; fidgety.

elect.def: Chosen; taken by preference from among two or more.

towed.def: Past tense or past participle of tow; The coarse and broken part of flax or hemp, separated from the finer part by the hatchel or swingle.

mixer.def: One who, or that which, mixes.

tides.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of tid; Tender; soft; nice; .

sheik.def: The head of an Arab family, or of a clan or a tribe; also, the chief magistrate of an Arab village.

silva.def: The forest trees of a region or country, considered collectively.

deuce.def: Two; a card or a die with two spots; as, the deuce of hearts.

lambs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of lamb; (Zoöl.) The young of the sheep.

pines.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of pin; To peen; To inclose; to confine; to pen; to pound.

yahoo.def: One of a race of filthy brutes in Swift's "Gulliver's Travels." See in the Dictionary of Noted Names in Fiction.

pious.def: Of or pertaining to piety; exhibiting piety; reverential; dutiful; religious; devout; godly.

wines.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of win; To gain by superiority in competition or contest; to obtain by victory over competitors or rivals; as, to win the prize in a gate; to win money; to win a battle, or to win a country.

moods.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of mood; Manner; style; mode; logical form; musical style; manner of action or being.

weber.def: The standard unit of electrical quantity, and also of current.

harem.def: The apartments or portion of the house allotted to females in Mohammedan families.

proxy.def: The agency for another who acts through the agent; authority to act for another, esp.

timed.def: Past tense or past participle of time; Duration, considered independently of any system of measurement or any employment of terms which designate limited portions thereof.

lumps.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of lump; A small mass of matter of irregular shape; an irregular or shapeless mass; as, a lump of coal; a lump of iron ore.

thong.def: A strap of leather; especially, one used for fastening anything.

paged.def: Past tense or past participle of page; A serving boy; formerly, a youth attending a person of high degree, especially at courts, as a position of honor and education; now commonly, in England, a youth employed for doin errands, waiting on the door, and similar service in households; in the United States, a boy emploed to wait upon the members of a legislative body.

crypt.def: A vault wholly or partly under ground; especially, a vault under a church, whether used for burial purposes or for a subterranean chapel or oratory.

teeny.def: Very small; tiny; [Colloq.] Fretful; peevish; pettish; cross.

ample.def: Large; great in size, extent, capacity, or bulk; spacious; roomy; widely extended.

clang.def: To strike together so as to produce a ringing metallic sound.

taels.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of tael; A denomination of money, in China, worth nearly six shillings sterling, or about a dollar and forty cents; also, a weight of one ounce and a third.

icing.def: A coating or covering resembling ice, as of sugar and milk or white of egg; frosting.

gorge.def: The throat; the gullet; the canal by which food passes to the stomach.

fakes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of fake; One of the circles or windings of a cable or hawser, as it lies in a coil; a single turn or coil.

terra.def: The earth; earth; Terra alba Etym: [L., white earth] , a white amorphous earthy substance consisting of burnt gypsum, aluminium silicate , or some similar ingredient, as magnesia.

irons.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of iron; The most common and most useful metallic element, being of almost universal occurrence, usually in the form of an oxide , or a hydrous oxide.

saxon.def: One of a nation or people who formerly dwelt in the nothern part of Germany, and who, with other Teutonic tribes, invaded and conquered England in the fifth and sixth centuries.

amaze.def: To bewilder; to stupefy; to bring into a maze.

limbo.def: An extramundane region where certain classes of souls were supposed to await the judgment.

cedar.def: The name of several evergreen trees.

bends.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bend; To strain or move out of a straight line; to crook by straining; to make crooked; to curve; to make ready for use by drawing into a curve; as, to bend a bow; to bend the knee.

graft.def: A small shoot or scion of a tree inserted in another tree, the stock of which is to support and nourish it.

gulps.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of gulp; To swallow eagerly, or in large draughts; to swallow up; to take down at one swallow.

hints.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of hint; To bring to mind by a slight mention or remote allusion; to suggest in an indirect manner; as, to hint a suspicion.

puffs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of puff; A sudden and single emission of breath from the mouth; hence, any sudden or short blast of wind; a slight gust; a whiff.

ticks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of tick; Credit; trust; as, to buy on, or upon, tick.

drool.def: To drivel, or drop saliva; as, the child drools.

plugs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of plug; Any piece of wood, metal, or other substance used to stop or fill a hole; a stopple.

piled.def: Having a pile or point; pointed.

dover.def: One who or that which performs the action of dove, or comparative form; (Zoöl.) A pigeon of the genus Columba and various related genera.

aroma.def: The quality or principle of plants or other substances which constitutes their fragrance; agreeable odor; as, the aroma of coffee.

atlas.def: One who sustains a great burden.

volts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of volt; A circular tread; a gait by which a horse going sideways round a center makes two concentric tracks.

whirs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of whir; To whirl round, or revolve, with a whizzing noise; to fly or more quickly with a buzzing or whizzing sound; to whiz.

birch.def: A tree of several species, constituting the genus Betula; as, the white or common birch ; the dwarf birch ; the paper or canoe birch ; the yellow birch ; the black or cherry birch.

swoop.def: To fall on at once and seize; to catch while on the wing; as, a hawk swoops a chicken.

quill.def: One of the large feathers of a bird's wing, or one of the rectrices of the tail; also, the stock of such a feather.

carts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of cart; A common name for various kinds of vehicles, as a Scythian dwelling on wheels, or a chariot.

cords.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of cord; A string, or small rope, composed of several strands twisted together.

floss.def: The slender styles of the pistillate flowers of maize; also called silk.

vogue.def: The way or fashion of people at any particular time; temporary mode, custom, or practice; popular reception for the time;.

privy.def: Of or pertaining to some person exclusively; assigned to private uses; not public; private; as, the privy purse.

hoist.def: To raise; to lift; to elevate; esp., to raise or lift to a desired elevation, by means of tackle, as a sail, a flag, a heavy package or weight.

hunts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of hunt; To search for or follow after, as game or wild animals; to chase; to pursue for the purpose of catching or killing; to follow with dogs or guns for sport or exercise; as, to hunt a deer.

mules.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of mule; (Zoöl.) A hybrid animal; specifically, one generated between an ass and a mare, sometimes a horse and a she-ass.

bland.def: Mild; soft; gentle; smooth and soothing in manner; suave; as, a bland temper; bland persuasion; a bland sycophant.

heirs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of heir; One who inherits, or is entitled to succeed to the possession of, any property after the death of its owner; one on whom the law bestows the title or property of another at the death of the latter.

britt.def: The young of the common herring; also, a small species of herring; the sprat.

viola.def: A genus of polypetalous herbaceous plants, including all kinds of violets.

cisco.def: The Lake herring , valuable food fish of the Great Lakes of North America.

cinch.def: A strong saddle girth, as of canvas.

mater.def: mater, Dura mater, and Pia mater.

speck.def: The blubber of whales or other marine mammals; also, the fat of the hippopotamus.

croft.def: A small, inclosed field, adjoining a house; a small farm.

lurch.def: To swallow or eat greedily; to devour; hence, to swallow up.

vines.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of vine; Any woody climbing plant which bears grapes.

doves.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of dove; (Zoöl.) A pigeon of the genus Columba and various related genera.

saber.def: A sword with a broad and heavy blade, thick at the back, and usually more or less curved like a scimiter; a cavalry sword.

sleet.def: The part of a mortar extending from the chamber to the trunnions.

curls.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of curl; To twist or form into ringlets; to crisp, as the hair.

cures.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of cur; A mongrel or inferior dog.

shawl.def: A square or oblong cloth of wool, cotton, silk, or other textile or netted fabric, used, especially by women, as a loose covering for the neck and shoulders.

satin.def: A silk cloth, of a thick, close texture, and overshot woof, which has a glossy surface.

canon.def: A law or rule; Or that the Everlasting had not fixed His canon 'gainst self- slaughter.

jiffy.def: A moment; an instant; as, I will be ready in a jiffy.

caddy.def: A small box, can, or chest to keep tea in.

clans.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of clan; A tribe or collection of families, united under a chieftain, regarded as having the same common ancestor, and bearing the same surname; as, the clan of Macdonald.

mayer.def: One who or that which performs the action of may, or comparative form; An auxiliary verb qualifyng the meaning of another verb, by expressing: Ability, competency, or possibility;.

friar.def: A brother or member of any religious order, but especially of one of the four mendicant orders, viz: Minors, Gray Friars, or Franciscans.

latex.def: A milky or colored juice in certain plants in cavities.

dames.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of dam; A female parent; , especially of quadrupeds; sometimes applied in contempt to a human mother.

atone.def: To set at one; to reduce to concord; to reconcile, as parties at variance; to appease.

tolls.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of toll; To take away; to vacate; to annul.

emery.def: Corundum in the form of grains or powder, used in the arts for grinding and polishing hard substances.

fluke.def: The part of an anchor which fastens in the ground; a flook.

raced.def: Past tense or past participle of race; A game, match, etc., open only to losers in early stages of contests.

groin.def: The snout of a swine; [Obs.] Chaucer.

urged.def: Past tense or past participle of urge; To press; to push; to drive; to impel; to force onward.

rapes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of rap; A lay or skein containing 120 yards of yarn.

cones.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of con; - (cum, signifying with, together, etc.

menus.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of menu; The details of a banquet; a bill of fare.

fixes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of fix; Fixed; solidified; [Obs.] Chaucer.

drags.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of drag; A confection; a comfit; a drug.

lupus.def: A cutaneous disease occurring under two distinct forms.

murky.def: Dark; obscure; gloomy; "The murkiest den." Shak.

bores.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of bore; To perforate or penetrate, as a solid body, by turning an auger, gimlet, drill, or other instrument; to make a round hole in or through; to pierce; as, to bore a plank.

caper.def: To leap or jump about in a sprightly manner; to cut capers; to skip; to spring; to prance; to dance.

chink.def: A small cleft, rent, or fissure, of greater length than breadth; a gap or crack; as, the chinks of wall.

forte.def: The strong point; that in which one excels.

discs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of disc; A flat round plate; a circular structure either in plants or animals; as, a blood disc, a germinal disc, etc.

ghoul.def: An imaginary evil being among Eastern nations, which was supposed to feed upon human bodies.

torah.def: A law; a precept; A considerable body of priestly Toroth.

hymns.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of hymn; An ode or song of praise or adoration; especially, a religious ode, a sacred lyric; a song of praise or thankgiving intended to be used in religious service; as, the Homeric hymns; Watts' hymns.

grits.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of grit; Sand or gravel; rough, hard particles.

sable.def: (Zoöl.) A carnivorous animal of the Weasel family native of the northern latitudes of Europe, Asia, and America, , soft, and valuable fur.

erupt.def: To cause to burst forth; to eject; as, to erupt lava.

weeps.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of weep; The lapwing; the wipe;; imp.

plumb.def: A little mass or weight of lead, or the like, attached to a line, and used by builders, etc., to indicate a vertical direction; a plummet; a plumb bob.

voter.def: One who votes; one who has a legal right to vote, or give his suffrage; an elector; a suffragist; as, as, an independent voter.

studs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of stud; A collection of breeding horses and mares, or the place where they are kept; also, a number of horses kept for a racing, riding, etc.

taker.def: One who takes or receives; one who catches or apprehended.

beryl.def: A mineral of great hardness, and, when transparent, of much beauty.

dozed.def: Past tense or past participle of doze; To slumber; to sleep lightly; to be in a dull or stupefied condition, as if half asleep; to be drowsy.

flier.def: One who flies or flees; a runaway; a fugitive.

toads.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of toad; Any one of numerous species of batrachians belonging to the genus Bufo and allied genera, especially those of the family Bufonidæ.

puree.def: A dish made by boiling any article of food to a pulp and rubbing it through a sieve; as, a purée of fish, or of potatoes; especially, a soup the thickening of which is so treated.

leaky.def: Permitting water or other fluid to leak in or out; as, a leaky roof or cask.

famed.def: Past tense or past participle of fame; Public report or rumor; The fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house.

onset.def: A rushing or setting upon; an attack; an assault; a storming; especially, the assault of an army.

acids.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of acid; Sour, sharp, or biting to the taste; tart; having the taste of vinegar: as, acid fruits or liquors.

frock.def: A loose outer garment; especially, a gown forming a part of European modern costume for women and children; also, a coarse hirtlike garment worn by some workmen over their ther clothes; a smock frock; as, a marketman's frock.

olden.def: Old; ancient; as, the olden time.

gourd.def: A fleshy, three-celled, many-seeded fruit, as the melon, pumpkin, cucumber, etc., of the order Cucurbitaceæ; and especially the bottle gourd which occurs in a great variety of forms, and, when the interior part is removed, serves for bottles, dippers, cups, and other dishes.

gummy.def: Consisting of gum; viscous; adhesive; producing or containing gum; covered with gum or a substance resembling gum.

fibre.def: One of the delicate, threadlike portions of which the tissues of plants and animals are in part constituted; as, the fiber of flax or of muscle.

koala.def: A tailless marsupial , found in Australia.

booms.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of boom; A long pole or spar, run out for the purpose of extending the bottom of a particular sail; as, the jib boom, the studding-sail boom, etc.

kites.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of kit; To cut; [Obs.] Chaucer.

stirs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of stir; To change the place of in any manner; to move.

kiosk.def: A small open-fronted hut or cubicle from which newspapers, refreshments, or tickets are sold.

roped.def: Past tense or past participle of rope; A large, stout cord, usually one not less than an inch in circumference, made of strands twisted or braided together.

usage.def: The act of using; mode of using or treating; treatment; conduct with respect to a person or a thing; as, good usage; ill usage; hard usage.

stabs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of stab; To pierce with a pointed weapon; to wound or kill by the thrust of a pointed instrument; as, to stab a man with a dagger; also, to thrust; as, to stab a dagger into a person.

nappy.def: Inclined to sleep; sleepy; as, to feel nappy.

fixer.def: One who or that which performs the action of fix, or comparative form; Fixed; solidified; [Obs.] Chaucer.

druid.def: One of an order of priests which in ancient times existed among certain branches of the Celtic race, especially among the Gauls and Britons.

pores.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of pore; One of the minute orifices in an animal or vegetable membrane, for transpiration, absorption, etc.

boing.def: Present participle or gerund of bo; An exclamation used to startle or frighten.

gusto.def: Nice or keen appreciation or enjoyment; relish; taste; fancy.

libel.def: A brief writing of any kind, esp.

tinny.def: Pertaining to, abounding with, or resembling, tin.

ebony.def: A hard, heavy, and durable wood, which admits of a fine polish or gloss.

malls.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of mall; A large heavy wooden beetle; a mallet for driving anything with force; a maul.

clout.def: A cloth; a piece of cloth or leather; a patch; a rag.

flunk.def: To fail, as on a lesson; to back out, as from an undertaking, through fear.

knave.def: A boy; especially, a boy servant.

foyer.def: A lobby in a theater; a greenroom.

miser.def: A wretched person; a person afflicted by any great misfortune.

batty.def: Belonging to, or resembling, a bat.

sabre.def: A sword with a broad and heavy blade, thick at the back, and usually more or less curved like a scimiter; a cavalry sword.

cally.def: In a manner characterized by being cal; Wolfram, an ore of tungsten.

mixes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of mix; To cause a promiscuous interpenetration of the parts of, as of two or more substances with each other, or of one substance with others; to unite or blend into one mass or compound, as by stirring together; to mingle; to blend; as, to mix flour and salt; to mix wines.

roddy.def: Full of rods or twigs; Ruddy.

dazed.def: Past tense or past participle of daze; To stupefy with excess of light; with a blow, with cold, or with fear; to confuse; to benumb.

prawn.def: Any one of numerous species of large shrimplike Crustacea having slender legs and long antennæ.

hells.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of hell; The place of the dead, or of souls after death; the grave; , and by the Greeks hades.

sexes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of sex; The distinguishing peculiarity of male or female in both animals and plants; the physical difference between male and female; the assemblage of properties or qualities by which male is distinguished from female.

swirl.def: To whirl, or cause to whirl, as in an eddy.

taint.def: A thrust with a lance, which fails of its intended effect.

jails.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of jail; A kind of prison; a building for the confinement of persons held in lawful custody, especially for minor offenses or with reference to some future judicial proceeding.

renal.def: Of or pertaining to the kidneys; in the region of the kidneys.

clasp.def: To shut or fasten together with, or as with, a clasp; to shut or fasten.

sutra.def: A precept; an aphorism; a brief rule.

afoot.def: On foot; We 'll walk afoot a while.

sixes.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of six; One more than five; twice three; as, six yards.

feral.def: Wild; untamed; ferine; not domesticated; , birds, and plants.

saheb.def: A respectful title or appelation given to Europeans of rank.

rouse.def: To pull or haul strongly and all together, as upon a rope, without the assistance of mechanical appliances.

taunt.def: Very high or tall; as, a ship with taunt masts.

cited.def: Past tense or past participle of cite; To call upon officially or authoritatively to appear, as before a court; to summon.

heats.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of heat; A force in nature which is recognized in various effects, but especially in the phenomena of fusion and evaporation, and which, as manifested in fire, the sun's rays, mechanical action, chemical combination, etc., becomes directly known to us through the sense of feeling.

brant.def: A species of wild goose; The name is also applied to other related species.

plait.def: A flat fold; a doubling, as of cloth; a pleat; as, a box plait.

soaps.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of soap; A substance which dissolves in water, thus forming a lather, and is used as a cleansing agent.

crass.def: Cross; thick; dense; coarse; not elaborated or refined.

baber.def: One who or that which performs the action of bab, or comparative form; Lit., gate; , and taken from that of Bab-ud-Din, assumed by him.

acorn.def: The fruit of the oak, being an oval nut growing in a woody cup or cupule.

nomad.def: One of a race or tribe that has no fixed location, but wanders from place to place in search of pasture or game.

fryer.def: One who or that which performs the action of fry, or comparative form; To cook in a pan or on a griddle by heating over a fire; to cook in boiling lard or fat; as, to fry fish; to fry doughnuts.

gilly.def: A boy or young man; a manservant; a male attendant, in the Scottish Highlands.

tweed.def: A soft and flexible fabric for men's wear, made wholly of wool except in some inferior kinds, the wool being dyed, usually in two colors, before weaving.

clogs.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of clog; That which hinders or impedes motion; hence, an encumbrance, restraint, or impediment, of any kind.

stoke.def: To stick; to thrust; to stab.

litre.def: A measure of capacity in the metric system, being a cubic decimeter, equal to 61.022 cubic inches, or 2.113 American pints, or 1.76 English pints.

ducts.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of duct; Any tube or canal by which a fluid or other substance is conducted or conveyed.

pubes.def: The hair which appears upon the lower part of the hypogastric region at the age of puberty.

rummy.def: Of or pertaining to rum; characteristic of rum; as a rummy flavor.

toddy.def: A juice drawn from various kinds of palms in the East Indies; or, a spirituous liquor procured from it by fermentation.

rages.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of rag; To scold or rail at; to rate; to tease; to torment; to banter.

hacks.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of hack; A frame or grating of various kinds; as, a frame for drying bricks, fish, or cheese; a rack for feeding cattle; a grating in a mill race, etc.

avert.def: To turn aside, or away; as, to avert the eyes from an object; to ward off, or prevent, the occurrence or effects of; as, how can the danger be averted "To avert his ire." Milton.

baggy.def: Resembling a bag; loose or puffed out, or pendent, like a bag; flabby; as, baggy trousers; baggy cheeks.

thane.def: A dignitary under the Anglo-Saxons and Danes in England.

chats.def: Plural form or third-person singular present of chat; To talk in a light and familiar manner; to converse without form or ceremony; to gossip.

prism.def: A solid whose bases or ends are any similar, equal, and parallel plane figures, and whose sides are parallelograms.

janus.def: A Latin deity represented with two faces looking in opposite directions.

swish.def: To flourish, so as to make the sound swish.

prose.def: The ordinary language of men in speaking or writing; language not cast in poetical measure or rhythm; , or metrical composition.

norse.def: Of or pertaining to ancient Scandinavia, or to the language spoken by its inhabitants.
